In addition, the framework provides a scenario generation module that records driving logs, allowing diverse and reproducible test cases to be constructed from human-in-the-loop experiments. Experimental results demonstrate that CommonRoad-Game achieves stable temporal synchronization, supports scalable multi-agent simulation, and seamlessly integrates CommonRoad-compatible motion planners to generate interactive driving scenarios. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Yunfei-Bi8/CommonRoad-Game.
summary_zh: 运动规划算法应在人在回路环境中进行评估，以确保其在交互过程中产生安全高效的行为。然而，现有仿真平台往往依赖录制的数据集，缺乏实时人机交互的专用接口，或与自动驾驶生态系统的集成度较弱。此外，许多人在回路模拟器在设计上计算密集，使其难以适用于自动驾驶早期研究中的快速原型开发与灵活实验。为解决这些问题，我们提出CommonRoad-Game，一个轻量级人在回路仿真框架，它与CommonRoad平台紧密集成，重点关注人类参与下运动规划器的系统性测试以及交互场景中人类驾驶行为的分析。我们采用多线程架构并配备稳健的同步机制，使仿真时间与挂钟时间对齐，从而实现自动驾驶车辆与人类驾驶车辆之间确定且时间一致的交互。此外，该框架还提供了一个记录驾驶日志的场景生成模块，能够从人在回路实验中构建多样化且可复现的测试案例。实验结果表明，CommonRoad-Game实现了稳定的时间同步，支持可扩展的多智能体仿真，并能无缝集成兼容CommonRoad的运动规划器以生成交互式驾驶场景。源代码已在https://github.com/Yunfei-Bi8/CommonRoad-Game公开。
tldr: CommonRoad-Game is a lightweight, human-in-the-loop simulation framework for autonomous driving that integrates with the CommonRoad platform, enabling real-time interaction between human drivers and motion planners with deterministic temporal synchronization.
tldr_zh: CommonRoad-Game 是一个轻量级、人在环路的自动驾驶仿真框架，与 CommonRoad 平台集成，支持人类驾驶员与运动规划器之间的实时交互，并实现确定性的时间同步。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Safety Guidance for Vision-Language-Action Models via Constrained Flow Matching
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated promising generalization capabilities across robotic manipulation tasks, yet their real-world deployment remains limited by the lack of effective safety measures. Specifically, existing safety measures only prevent collisions caused by the robot's next action. In this paper, we propose a neuro-symbolic safety guidance mechanism for flow matching based VLAs that enables predictive collision avoidance. Flow matching based VLAs determine the next actions by predicting a trajectory (a sequence of actions) through an iterative neural flow matching process. Our method formulates safety enforcement as a minimum-norm constrained optimization problem that corrects safety violations during the denoising process of noisy intermediate trajectory predictions. By analyzing predicted trajectories and applying corrections during iterative denoising, our approach anticipates collisions before they become unavoidable. This interleaving of symbolic constraint satisfaction with neural trajectory generation enables predictive collision avoidance rather than reactive intervention. On the SafeLIBERO benchmark, our method achieves 82.8% collision avoidance and 81.6% task success, a 6.3% and 19.8% improvement respectively over single-step methods, with the largest gains on long-horizon tasks where compounding distribution shift is most pronounced. Video demonstrations of our approach are included on our project page at https://willenglish.tech/SafetyGuidedFlowMatching/.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作任务中展现出了良好的泛化能力，但其实际部署仍因缺乏有效的安全措施而受到限制。具体而言，现有安全措施仅能防止由机器人下一步动作引发的碰撞。本文针对基于流匹配的VLA模型，提出了一种神经符号融合的安全引导机制，实现了预测性碰撞避免。基于流匹配的VLA模型通过迭代神经流匹配过程预测轨迹（一系列动作序列）来确定下一步动作。我们的方法将安全强制执行构建为一个最小范数约束优化问题，在噪声中间轨迹预测的去噪过程中修正安全违规行为。通过分析预测轨迹并在迭代去噪过程中施加修正，该方法能在碰撞变得不可避免之前提前预判。这种将符号约束满足与神经轨迹生成交错结合的方式，实现了预测性碰撞避免而非被动响应式干预。在SafeLIBERO基准测试中，我们的方法实现了82.8%的碰撞避免率和81.6%的任务成功率，相比单步方法分别提升了6.3%和19.8%，在复合分布偏移最为显著的长时域任务中获得了最大增益。项目页面（https://willenglish.tech/SafetyGuidedFlowMatching/）包含了本方法的视频演示。
tldr: Proposes a neuro-symbolic safety mechanism for flow-matching-based VLA models that corrects unsafe trajectory predictions during the denoising process, achieving predictive collision avoidance and improved task success on the SafeLIBERO benchmark.
tldr_zh: 针对基于流匹配的视觉-语言-动作模型，提出了一种神经符号安全机制，在去噪过程中修正不安全的轨迹预测，实现预测性碰撞避免，并在SafeLIBERO基准上提升了任务成功率。

title: Path-level Hindsight Instructions for Semantic Exploration in Vision-Language Navigation
summary: On-policy exploration is a crucial component for training robust Vision-Language Navigation agents, as it exposes the policy to a broader state distribution. However, such exploration inevitably leads to trajectories that deviate from expert demonstrations, resulting in a semantic mismatch between the executed visual stream and the original language instruction. In this work, we address this challenge by introducing Phi-Nav, a unified on-policy framework that leverages hindsight reasoning to align instructions with the agent's actual exploratory journey. Specifically, Phi-Nav operates through a three-stage dual-supervision cycle: 1) the agent performs oracle-guided on-policy exploration, sampling a trajectory while learning from expert action feedback, 2) a hindsight speaker synthesizes a path-level hindsight instruction grounded in the collected visual observations, and 3) the agent conducts a second imitation pass, treating the synthesized trajectory-instruction pair as an additional expert demonstration. Through this process, Phi-Nav bridges the critical semantic supervision gap inherent in on-policy methods, transforming semantically unlabeled movement into dense training signals. Evaluations on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks show that Phi-Nav yields competitive performance while requiring only a fraction of the expert demonstrations used by current baselines. These results underscore the necessity of semantic exploration in VLN, positioning Phi-Nav as an effective solution for training embodied agents with limited data.
summary_zh: 在策略探索是训练鲁棒视觉-语言导航智能体的关键组成部分，因为它能使策略暴露于更广泛的状态分布中。然而，这种探索不可避免地会导致轨迹偏离专家演示，从而在执行的视觉流与原始语言指令之间产生语义错配。在本工作中，我们通过引入Phi-Nav应对这一挑战，这是一种统一在策略框架，利用事后推理将指令与智能体的实际探索轨迹对齐。具体而言，Phi-Nav通过三个阶段的双重监督循环运行：1）智能体执行基于专家引导的在策略探索，在采样轨迹的同时从专家动作反馈中学习；2）一个事后说话者合成基于收集的视觉观测的路径级事后指令；3）智能体执行第二次模仿学习，将合成的轨迹-指令对视为额外的专家演示。通过这一过程，Phi-Nav弥合了在策略方法中关键的语义监督缺口，将无语义标签的运动转换为密集的训练信号。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准上的评估表明，Phi-Nav在仅使用当前基线方法所用专家演示的一小部分的情况下，获得了具有竞争力的性能。这些结果强调了语义探索在视觉-语言导航中的必要性，并将Phi-Nav定位为在有限数据条件下训练具身智能体的有效解决方案。
tldr: Phi-Nav introduces a three-stage hindsight reasoning framework to bridge the semantic gap in on-policy exploration for Vision-Language Navigation, enabling agents to learn from their own exploratory trajectories with synthesized path-level instructions.
tldr_zh: Phi-Nav 提出了一种三阶段事后推理框架，以弥合视觉-语言导航中在线策略探索的语义鸿沟，使智能体能够从自身的探索轨迹中学习，通过合成的路径级指令进行训练。

title: WorldDirector: Building Controllable World Simulators with Persistent Dynamic Memory
summary: We present WorldDirector, a highly controllable video world model framework designed for persistent dynamic object memory and unrestricted viewpoint exploration. Unlike existing world models that entangle physical dynamics with pixel rendering and rely on continuous visual observation to sustain motion, our framework explicitly decouples semantic motion orchestration from visual generation. By leveraging an LLM to coordinate 3D trajectories with camera movements and subsequently employing these orchestrated trajectories as control signals for video generation, our approach ensures strict physical logic and appearance stability, successfully preserving the exact visual identities of dynamic entities even when they re-enter the scene after prolonged periods out of view. Experimental results demonstrate that our method supports the synthesis of complex and extended events with unprecedented controllability and persistent dynamic object memory. Project Page: https://worlddirector.github.io/
summary_zh: 我们提出了WorldDirector，一种高可控性的视频世界模型框架，专为持久性动态物体记忆与无限制视角探索而设计。与现有将物理动态与像素渲染相纠缠、并依赖连续视觉观测维持运动的世界模型不同，本框架明确将语义运动编排与视觉生成解耦。通过利用大语言模型协调三维轨迹与摄像机运动，随后将这些编排好的轨迹作为视频生成的控制信号，我们的方法确保了严格的物理逻辑与外观稳定性，成功保留了动态实体在长时间离开视野后重新进入场景时的精确视觉身份。实验结果表明，本方法支持以空前的可控性与持久性动态物体记忆，合成复杂且持续时间较长的事件。项目页面：https://worlddirector.github.io/
tldr: WorldDirector introduces a framework that uses an LLM to coordinate 3D trajectories for controllable video world models, enabling persistent dynamic object memory and unrestricted viewpoint exploration.
tldr_zh: WorldDirector 提出了一个框架，利用大语言模型协调 3D 轨迹以实现可控视频世界模型，支持持久动态物体记忆和无限制视角探索。

title: Seek to Segment: Active Perception for Panoramic Referring Segmentation
summary: Existing referring segmentation models passively process static images captured from fixed perspectives, limiting their applicability in Embodied AI, where agents must perform active perception in the continuous 360$^\circ$ environments. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel task: Active Panoramic Referring Segmentation (APRS). In this setting, an agent is required to adjust its viewing direction ($Δθ, Δφ$) to explore the 360$^\circ$ environment, seeking the object specified by a user instruction for segmentation. To tackle this challenging task, we propose PanoSeeker, a memory-augmented agent for efficient APRS. Rather than relying on heuristic scanning, PanoSeeker integrates a Vision-Language Model (VLM) with EgoSphere, an explicit spatial visual memory. By progressively integrating sequential local observations into a unified 360$^\circ$ representation, EgoSphere enables the agent to plan efficient and non-redundant search trajectories. Once the target is found, the agent performs active viewpoint alignment and outputs the segmentation mask. Furthermore, we curate an expert-annotated search trajectory dataset with memory timelines for Supervised Fine-Tuning, followed by Reinforcement Learning post-training to explicitly optimize PanoSeeker's exploration efficiency. Extensive experiments on our newly established APRS benchmark demonstrate that PanoSeeker achieves superior search efficiency and segmentation accuracy, significantly outperforming adapted state-of-the-art baselines.
summary_zh: 现有的指代分割模型被动处理固定视角下的静态图像，限制了其在具身人工智能中的应用——这类场景要求智能体在连续360°环境中进行主动感知。为弥合这一差距，我们提出新任务：主动全景指代分割（APRS）。在该设定下，智能体需通过调整视角（Δθ, Δφ）探索360°环境，寻找用户指令指定的目标物体进行分割。为攻克这一挑战性任务，我们提出PanoSeeker——一种用于高效APRS的记忆增强型智能体。与依赖启发式扫描不同，PanoSeeker将视觉-语言模型（VLM）与显式空间视觉记忆EgoSphere相结合。通过将顺序局部观测逐步整合为统一的360°表征，EgoSphere使智能体能够规划高效且无冗余的搜索轨迹。一旦发现目标，智能体将执行主动视角对齐并输出分割掩码。此外，我们构建了包含记忆时间线的专家标注搜索轨迹数据集用于监督微调，随后通过强化学习后训练显式优化PanoSeeker的探索效率。在我们新建立的APRS基准上的大量实验表明，PanoSeeker在搜索效率和分割精度上均显著超越经过适配的最先进基线模型。
tldr: This paper introduces Active Panoramic Referring Segmentation (APRS), a new task for embodied agents to actively explore 360-degree environments via view adjustments to segment objects based on user instructions, and proposes PanoSeeker, a VLM-based agent with explicit spatial memory that achieves efficient search and accurate segmentation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出主动全景指代分割（APRS）新任务，要求具身代理通过调整视角主动探索360度环境以分割用户指令指定的物体，并设计了融合显式空间记忆的VLM代理PanoSeeker，实现了高效搜索与精准分割。

title: Open-Weather Robust 3D Detection via Dual-Critic Diffusion Alignment
summary: Robust 3D object detection under adverse weather remains a critical hurdle for autonomous driving. Despite progress with LiDAR-4D radar fusion, most methods are constrained by a closed-world assumption, implicitly requiring training and test weather to align in both type and severity. This premise fails in practice: the open-ended nature of weather, and even variations within a single type like rain, cause dramatically different LiDAR degradation patterns, leading to significant performance drops in unseen conditions. To address this, we present Dual-Critic Guided Diffusion Alignment (DCDA), a weather-agnostic framework that learns to recover degraded LiDAR features toward a clean manifold. Rather than modeling specific weather types, DCDA employs a 4D radar-conditioned diffusion process to progressively refine features, guided by two complementary critics. (i) A detection-guided critic, anchored by a pre-trained clean-weather model, ensures that the refined features retain object-level discriminability and localization accuracy. (ii) A weather adversarial critic enforces holistic distributional consistency with clean-weather representations. By aligning features through semantic and distributional constraints rather than explicit weather modeling, DCDA generalizes effectively to unseen weather types and severities without requiring paired data or weather labels. We further introduce a structured open-weather benchmark with held-out type-severity combinations and extensive experiments verify DCDA's advantages.
summary_zh: 在恶劣天气条件下的鲁棒三维物体检测仍是自动驾驶面临的关键挑战。尽管基于激光雷达与四维毫米波雷达融合的方法已取得进展，但多数方法受限于封闭世界假设，隐含要求训练与测试时的天气类型和强度保持一致。这一前提在实践中难以成立：天气的开放性本质，甚至单一雨雪天气内部的强度变化，都会引发截然不同的激光雷达退化模式，导致模型在未见过的天气条件下性能显著下降。为此，我们提出双判别器引导扩散对齐方法（DCDA）——一种与天气类型无关的框架，通过学习将退化激光雷达特征恢复至干净流形。不同于针对特定天气类型建模，DCDA采用四维雷达条件扩散过程逐步优化特征，并由两个互补判别器协同引导：（i）基于预训练干净天气模型的检测引导判别器，确保优化后的特征保持物体级可判别性与定位精度；（ii）天气对抗判别器，强制特征整体分布与干净天气表征保持一致性。通过语义与分布约束而非显式天气建模实现特征对齐，DCDA可在无需配对数据或天气标签的情况下，有效泛化至未见过的天气类型与强度。我们进一步构建了包含保留型-强度组合的结构化开放天气基准，大量实验验证了DCDA的优势。
tldr: Proposes a dual-critic guided diffusion alignment framework (DCDA) that recovers degraded LiDAR features under diverse unseen weather conditions using 4D radar conditioning and both detection-guided and weather-adversarial critics, enabling weather-agnostic 3D detection for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种双鉴别器引导的扩散对齐框架（DCDA），利用4D雷达条件以及检测引导和天气对抗鉴别器，恢复在多种未见天气条件下退化的LiDAR特征，实现自动驾驶中的天气无关三维检测。

title: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models What to See and Where to Look
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing VLAs' training relies heavily on text-centric visual question answering and chain-of-thought reasoning data, which emphasizes linguistic reasoning rather than action-grounded planning. As a result, the learned representations capture semantic knowledge but lack spatial dependencies crucial for reliable trajectory prediction. We propose DriveTeach-VLA, a framework that explicitly teaches VLAs what to see and where to look. Driving-aware Vision Distillation (DVD) injects driving-specific perceptual priors into the vision encoder, while 2D Trajectory-Guided Prompts (2D-TGP) provide spatial conditioning aligned with feasible driving trajectories. Together, they form a vision-guided learning pipeline: what to see (DVD pretraining) - where to look (TGP-guided SFT) - how to act (TGP-guided GRPO). DriveTeach-VLA achieves the state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIM and nuScenes. Our code is available at: https://github.com/ShivaTeam/DriveTeach-VLA.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为端到端自动驾驶的一种有前景的范式。然而，现有VLA模型的训练严重依赖以文本为中心的视觉问答和思维链推理数据，这些数据强调语言推理而非基于动作的规划。因此，习得的表征虽能捕捉语义知识，但缺乏对可靠轨迹预测至关重要的空间依赖性。我们提出DriveTeach-VLA框架，该框架明确教导VLA模型“看什么”以及“往哪儿看”。驾驶感知视觉蒸馏（DVD）将驾驶特定的感知先验注入视觉编码器，而二维轨迹引导提示（2D-TGP）则提供与可行驾驶轨迹对齐的空间条件约束。二者共同构成视觉引导的学习流程：“看什么”（DVD预训练）→“往哪儿看”（TGP引导的监督微调）→“如何行动”（TGP引导的组相对策略优化）。DriveTeach-VLA在NAVSIM和nuScenes数据集上达到了最先进的性能。我们的代码开源在：https://github.com/ShivaTeam/DriveTeach-VLA。
tldr: DriveTeach-VLA enhances VLA models for autonomous driving by injecting driving-specific perceptual priors via DVD and providing spatial conditioning through 2D-TGP, achieving SOTA performance on NAVSIM and nuScenes.
tldr_zh: DriveTeach-VLA 通过DVD注入驾驶感知先验并使用2D-TGP提供空间条件，提升了VLA模型在自动驾驶中的性能，在NAVSIM和nuScenes上达到SOTA。

title: MapDreamer: Aerial Imagery Conditioned Latent Diffusion for Lane-Level Map Generation
summary: High definition map generation is essential for autonomous driving, yet remains a labor-intensive process at scale. We present MapDreamer, a generative diffusion model that synthesizes lane-level vector maps with explicit topology directly from a single aerial image. MapDreamer learns a compact latent representation of lane centerlines and their topological relations using a variational autoencoder and predicts graphs with a transformer-based latent diffusion model. To align generated maps with the observed scene, we condition each denoising step on dense aerial features injected through cross-attention. To handle the varying number of lanes across scenes, we propose a lane cardinality module paired with background ghost lane latents, a learned buffer that prevents slot collapse during diffusion. Furthermore, we introduce a sliding-window global graph aggregation strategy that stitches local tiles into city-scale maps while preserving connectivity through encoded lane boundaries. Experiments on UrbanLaneGraph derived from Argoverse 2 show improved geometric and topological fidelity over non-generative baselines.
summary_zh: 高清地图生成对自动驾驶至关重要，但在规模化应用中仍是一项劳动密集型过程。我们提出MapDreamer，这是一种生成式扩散模型，能够直接从单张航拍图像合成具有显式拓扑结构的车道级矢量地图。MapDreamer利用变分自编码器学习车道中心线及其拓扑关系的紧凑潜在表示，并通过基于Transformer的潜在扩散模型预测图结构。为使生成的地图与观测场景对齐，我们在每个去噪步骤中通过交叉注意力注入密集的航拍特征。为处理不同场景下车道数量的变化，我们提出车道基数模块，并引入背景幽灵车道潜在变量——一种学习缓冲机制，用于防止扩散过程中出现槽位坍缩。此外，我们提出滑动窗口全局图聚合策略，该策略在通过编码车道边界保持连通性的同时，将局部瓦片拼接为城市规模的地图。在源自Argoverse 2的UrbanLaneGraph数据集上的实验表明，与无生成能力的基线方法相比，MapDreamer在几何与拓扑保真度方面均有提升。
tldr: MapDreamer is a generative diffusion model that produces lane-level vector maps with topology from a single aerial image, improving map generation for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: MapDreamer是一种生成式扩散模型，能从单张航拍图像生成包含拓扑结构的车道级矢量地图，提升了自动驾驶地图生成的效率。

title: Actuator Reality Shaping for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Robot Learning
summary: Sim-to-real transfer in robot learning is often limited by discrepancies between the ideal actuator dynamics assumed during policy training and the nonlinear, hardware-dependent behavior of physical motors. While conventional approaches attempt to bridge this gap by increasing simulator fidelity through system identification, domain randomization, or learned actuator models, we introduce an alternative paradigm: actuator reality shaping. Instead of modifying the simulator to match the real world, our method shapes the closed-loop behavior of physical actuators to match the idealized second-order reference dynamics used in simulation. By equipping each joint with a two-degree-of-freedom feedforward--feedback controller, we decouple reference-response shaping from robust stabilization, thereby providing a standardized actuator interface for reinforcement learning policies. As a result, policies trained only with the prescribed reference model can be deployed zero-shot on real hardware without task-level fine-tuning or learned actuator models. We validate the approach on a single-joint high-gear-ratio servo under external loads and a 7-DOF robotic arm reaching task, where actuator reality shaping substantially reduces sim-to-real tracking error and improves zero-shot task performance compared with standard servo-control and representative real-to-sim-to-real baselines. We further demonstrate zero-shot transfer on a wheeled-legged robot driving over a slope and a humanoid robot walking, suggesting that actuator reality shaping can serve as a reusable interface for robot learning across diverse hardware platforms.
summary_zh: 模拟到现实迁移在机器人学习中常受限于策略训练假设的理想执行器动力学与实际电机非线性、硬件依赖行为之间的差异。传统方法试图通过系统辨识、域随机化或学习型执行器模型来提升仿真器保真度以弥合这一鸿沟，而本文提出了一种替代范式：执行器现实塑形。我们的方法并非修改仿真器以匹配真实世界，而是通过塑造物理执行器的闭环行为使其匹配仿真中使用的理想化二阶参考动力学。通过为每个关节配备双自由度前馈-反馈控制器，我们将参考响应塑形与鲁棒镇定解耦，从而为强化学习策略提供标准化执行器接口。如此一来，仅使用预设参考模型训练的策略可直接零次部署于真实硬件，无需任务级微调或学习型执行器模型。我们在外部负载下的单关节高减速比伺服系统及七自由度机械臂抓取任务中验证了该方法——相较于标准伺服控制及具有代表性的实到仿再到实基线方法，执行器现实塑形显著降低了模拟到现实跟踪误差并提升了零次任务性能。我们进一步展示了轮腿机器人在斜坡行驶及仿人机器人行走中的零次迁移效果，表明执行器现实塑形可作为跨异构硬件平台的机器人学习可复用接口。
tldr: This paper proposes actuator reality shaping, which modifies the closed-loop behavior of physical actuators to match idealized simulation dynamics, enabling zero-shot sim-to-real transfer across diverse robots without task-level fine-tuning or learned actuator models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出执行器现实塑造方法，通过修改物理执行器的闭环行为以匹配仿真中的理想化动力学，无需任务级微调或学习型执行器模型，即可在多种机器人上实现零样本的仿真到现实迁移。

title: Guided Action Flow: Q-Guided Inference for Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Flow-matching vision-language-action policies generate robot action chunks through an iterative transport process, creating an opportunity for test-time guidance without retraining the base policy. We study this opportunity in Guided Action Flow, an inference-time framework that keeps a pretrained SmolVLA policy frozen and uses a learned action-chunk critic to guide its reverse-time flow sampler. The critic is trained from real success and failure rollouts, can condition on task-description features from the frozen SmolVLA language pathway, and is used only through action gradients during sampling. We evaluate the approach on LIBERO manipulation tasks. A single-task critic improves success from 68.0% to 82.0% on one seed window and from 82.0% to 86.0% on another. A multi-family task-description critic improves validation success from 46.0% to 56.0%, while the locked held-out test gain is positive but modest, from 65.0% to 67.5%. These results support the feasibility of Q-guided inference for frozen flow-matching VLA policies, while showing that critic generalization and uncertainty-aware guidance remain the central bottlenecks.
summary_zh: 流程匹配的视觉-语言-动作策略通过迭代输运过程生成机器人动作块，这为在不重新训练基础策略的情况下进行测试时引导创造了机会。我们在引导动作流中研究这一机会，该框架是一种推理时框架，保持预训练的SmolVLA策略冻结，并利用学习到的动作块评判器来引导其反向时间流采样器。该评判器通过真实成功与失败展开数据训练，可基于冻结SmolVLA语言通路中的任务描述特征进行调节，且仅在采样过程中通过动作梯度发挥作用。我们在LIBERO操作任务上评估该方法。单任务评判器将某个种子窗口的成功率从68.0%提升至82.0%，在另一窗口上从82.0%提升至86.0%。多族任务描述评判器将验证集成功率从46.0%提升至56.0%，而锁定的保留测试集增益虽为正但较为有限，从65.0%提升至67.5%。这些结果证实了冻结流匹配VLA策略中Q引导推理的可行性，同时表明评判器泛化能力与不确定性感知引导仍是核心瓶颈。
tldr: This paper introduces Guided Action Flow, an inference-time framework that uses a learned action-chunk critic to guide the reverse-time flow sampler of a frozen flow-matching VLA policy, improving success rates on LIBERO manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Guided Action Flow，一种在推理时使用学习到的动作块批评器来引导冻结的流匹配VLA策略的逆向流采样器的框架，在LIBERO操作任务上提高了成功率。

title: Cross-Platform Control for Autonomous Surface Vehicles via Adaptive Reinforcement Learning
summary: Autonomous surface vehicles vary widely in hydrodynamic and actuation characteristics, yet most controllers are designed for single-platform deployment. We present an adaptive reinforcement learning approach for trajectory tracking that enables zero-shot cross-platform deployment using a single policy. Since the deployment platform's dynamics are unknown to the policy, we address cross-platform generalization with the standard partial-observability approach of conditioning on interaction history, employing a teacher-student architecture in which a learned module infers a latent representation of the platform dynamics. The policy is trained in simulation under randomized vessel dynamics and is deployed zero-shot to two real-world platforms without any fine-tuning, despite relying on a simple analytical dynamics model rather than a high-fidelity hydrodynamic simulator. In real-world experiments on two different platforms, the adaptive policy outperforms non-adaptive learning-based baselines by up to 58% in position mean absolute error while approaching the tracking accuracy of a platform-specific tuned controller.
summary_zh: 自主水面航行器在水动力学和驱动特性上差异显著，但目前多数控制器针对单一平台部署设计。我们提出一种自适应强化学习方法用于轨迹跟踪，能够通过单一策略实现零样本跨平台部署。由于部署平台的动力学特性对策略而言是未知的，我们采用以交互历史为条件的标准部分可观测方法来解决跨平台泛化问题，并采用教师-学生架构，其中学习模块推断平台动力学的潜在表征。该策略在随机航行器动力学条件下的仿真环境中训练，并零样本部署至两个真实平台，无需任何微调——尽管其仅依赖简单的解析动力学模型而非高保真水动力学仿真器。在两个不同平台的真实实验中，自适应策略的位置平均绝对误差相比非自适应学习基线方法最高降低58%，其跟踪精度接近平台专属调优控制器的水平。
tldr: This paper proposes an adaptive reinforcement learning approach for trajectory tracking in autonomous surface vehicles, enabling zero-shot cross-platform deployment via a teacher-student architecture that learns a latent representation of platform dynamics.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出一种自适应强化学习方法，用于自主水面车辆的轨迹跟踪，通过教师-学生架构学习平台动力学的潜在表示，实现零样本跨平台部署。

title: SPLC: Social Preference Learning for Crowd Robot Navigation
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) holds significant potential for crowd robot navigation in human-robot coexistence applications. However, the inherent complexity of pedestrian motion renders the design of effective reward functions for promoting socially compliant robot behaviors a persistent challenge. This paper proposes a Social Preference Learning for Crowd Robot Navigation (SPLC) algorithm to eliminate the need for detailed reward design. Its core innovation lies in the introduction of a social preference feedback mechanism to automatically generate preference data through principled preference evaluation criteria. By explicitly accounting for the intricacies of pedestrian dynamics, the pipeline mitigates the reward bias and facilitates the systematic quantification of broad social norms, thereby fostering socially compliant behaviors. Extensive experiments integrating SPLC with offline RL methods demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines across standard performance metrics. Furthermore, real-world experiments on the TurtleBot4 further validate the effectiveness of SPLC in practical human-robot coexistence settings. Our code and video demos are available at https://github.com/sklus949/SPLC.
summary_zh: 离线强化学习在人机共存应用中的群体机器人导航领域具有重要潜力。然而，行人运动的内在复杂性使得设计有效奖励函数以促进符合社会规范的机器人行为始终是一项挑战。本文提出一种用于群体机器人导航的社会偏好学习（SPLC）算法，以消除对精细奖励设计的依赖。其核心创新在于引入社会偏好反馈机制，通过原则性的偏好评价标准自动生成偏好数据。该框架通过显式考虑行人动力学的复杂性，能够缓解奖励偏差，并促进对广泛社会规范的系统性量化，从而激励符合社会规范的行为。将SPLC与离线强化学习方法相结合的广泛实验表明，该方法在标准性能指标上相较于最先进的基线方法取得了一致性改进。此外，在TurtleBot4上的真实世界实验进一步验证了SPLC在真实人机共存环境中的有效性。我们的代码与视频演示可在https://github.com/sklus949/SPLC获取。
tldr: This paper proposes SPLC, an offline RL algorithm that leverages a social preference feedback mechanism to automatically generate preference data for crowd robot navigation, eliminating the need for manual reward design and demonstrating improved performance in both simulation and real-world TurtleBot4 experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SPLC算法，通过社交偏好反馈机制自动生成偏好数据，无需手动设计奖励函数，实现更符合社交规范的机器人人群导航，并在TurtleBot4上验证了有效性。

title: A Reconfigurable Rocker-Bogie Robot for High Step Climbing and Turning
summary: This study proposes a reconfigurable rocker-bogie mechanism that achieves efficient turning motion with a small number of actuators while maintaining high step-climbing capability. By installing motors at the bogie joints and actively swinging up and down bogies, the system enables switching between four-wheel and six-wheel configurations. Omnidirectional wheels are mounted on the rear ends of the rockers, allowing smooth turning in the four-wheel configuration based on a differential-drive model. Experimental evaluation using a prototype robot demonstrated that the proposed mechanism achieves zero-radius turning at a speed more than five times that of a conventional rocker-bogie mechanism equipped with six non-steerable grip wheels, while requiring only approximately 17% of the total average wheel torque. In addition, the robot successfully climbed a 40 cm step with an average climbing time of 6.4 s, confirming its high turning and step-climbing performance.
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种可重构摇臂-转向架机构，该机构在保持高越障能力的同时，仅需少量执行器即可实现高效转向运动。通过在转向架关节处安装电机并主动控制转向架的上下摆动，系统能够实现四轮与六轮构型之间的切换。全向轮安装于摇臂后端，使机器人能在四轮构型下基于差速驱动模型实现平滑转向。基于样机进行的实验评估表明，与配备六个非转向抓地轮的常规摇臂-转向架机构相比，所提机构可实现零半径转向，速度提升五倍以上，且总平均车轮扭矩仅约为前者的17%。此外，该机器人成功攀越了40厘米台阶，平均攀越时间为6.4秒，验证了其出色的转向与越障性能。
tldr: This paper presents a reconfigurable rocker-bogie robot that actively controls bogie joints to switch between four-wheel and six-wheel configurations, enabling rapid zero-radius turning with low torque and high step-climbing ability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种可重构摇臂-转向架机器人，通过主动控制转向架关节在四轮和六轮构型间切换，实现低扭矩下的快速零半径转弯和高台阶攀爬能力。

title: Overthink-Triggered Slowdown Attacks on LVLM-Based Robotic Systems
summary:
Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have been increasingly integrated into robotic systems. However, these models may exhibit overthinking behaviors, where they generate excessively long reasoning traces, incurring an excessive inference time. This overthinking behavior poses a serious risk to robotic systems, as the adversary can deliberately trigger overthinking to slow down the decision making of a victim robotic system, causing a variety of safety issues (i.e., an overthinking-induced slowdown attack). To initiate this attack, an adversary can embed carefully crafted, human-readable scene text into the visual scene observed by a victim robotic agent, causing significant inference delays even under a strict black-box setting. Therefore, the embedded scene text serves as a significant "trigger" for the attack.
  This work systematically identifies and validates transferable triggers of overthinking in robotic systems by introducing a three-stage framework. First, we construct a diverse corpus of reasoning-intensive scene text and extract overthinking-correlated lexical features from short response prefixes. Second, we perform an efficient black-box search guided by a prefix-based proxy score while selectively confirming a small set of top candidates with full latency measurements. Third, we evaluate black-box transfer using a fixed pool of triggers on unseen images and multiple LVLMs, reporting latency amplification and attack success rates under standard thresholds. Across three representative LVLMs, all triggers yield slowdown ratios greater than 1.0x, with the strongest single-trigger case reaching 6.96x. The physical printing of the text trigger still causes up to 4.74x latency amplification. These results demonstrate that our discovered triggers are transferred between multiple LVLM models and consistently cause significant slowdowns in robotic systems.
summary_zh:
大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）正越来越多地被集成到机器人系统中。然而，这些模型可能表现出过度思考行为，即生成过长的推理链条，导致推理时间过长。这种过度思考行为对机器人系统构成严重威胁，因为攻击者可以故意触发过度思考，从而拖慢受害机器人系统的决策过程，引发各种安全问题（即过度思考引发的减速攻击）。为发起此类攻击，攻击者可将精心设计的、人类可读的场景文本嵌入到受害机器人智能体所观测的视觉场景中，即使在严格的黑盒设置下也能造成显著的推理延迟。因此，嵌入的场景文本成为该攻击的重要"触发器"。

本研究通过引入三阶段框架，系统性地识别并验证了机器人系统中过度思考的可迁移触发器。首先，我们构建了包含推理密集型场景文本的多样化语料库，并从短响应前缀中提取与过度思考相关的词汇特征。其次，我们以前缀代理得分为引导进行高效的黑盒搜索，同时通过完整延迟测量有选择地确认少量候选触发器。最后，我们在未见图像和多个LVLM上使用固定触发器池评估黑盒迁移性，报告标准阈值下的延迟放大倍数与攻击成功率。在三种代表性LVLM上，所有触发器均产生大于1.0倍的减速比，其中最强单触发器案例达到6.96倍。文本触发器的物理打印仍可导致高达4.74倍的延迟放大。这些结果表明，我们发现的触发器可在多个LVLM模型之间迁移，并持续对机器人系统造成显著减速。
tldr: This paper identifies and validates transferable scene-text triggers that cause overthinking-induced slowdown attacks on LVLM-based robotic systems, achieving latency amplification up to 6.96x in digital and 4.74x in physical settings.
tldr_zh: 本文发现并验证了可迁移的场景文本触发器，可对基于LVLM的机器人系统引发过度思考导致的减速攻击，在数字和物理环境下分别实现高达6.96倍和4.74倍的延迟放大。

title: SE(2) Navigation Mesh
summary: Global navigation for ground robots in complex multi-level environments requires representations that accurately capture traversable regions while enabling efficient path planning. Current approaches present key limitations: Point clouds and volumetric occupancy maps lack explicit surface structure for traversability estimation, whereas direct pathfinding on dense triangle meshes is computationally prohibitive. Navigation meshes mitigate these challenges through polygonal abstraction of the underlying mesh, but assume yaw-invariant traversability, rendering them unsuitable for non-circular robots in constrained spaces. We propose SE(2) Navigation Mesh (SE(2) NavMesh), a polygonal representation of traversable regions that encodes yaw-dependent traversability. Our method evaluates traversability using footprint masks and constructs a graph over yaw-specific layers with explicit translational and rotational connectivity. Grounded in this representation, we develop an A*-String Pulling-A* (ASA) pathfinding strategy that hierarchically optimizes robot position and heading. We also present an online method that incrementally updates the SE(2) NavMesh from streaming point clouds during concurrent geometry reconstruction. In simulation, the SE(2) NavMesh captures over 50% more traversable area than classical NavMeshes, and the SE(2) NavMesh + ASA pipeline consistently outperforms sampling-based baselines in constrained environments. Extensive real-world experiments on a physical robot validate real-time online generation and successful navigation across multiple environments.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
在复杂多层环境中实现地面机器人的全局导航，需要既能准确刻画可通行区域、又能支持高效路径规划的表示方法。现有方法存在关键局限：点云与体素占据地图缺乏显式表面结构以评估可通行性，而直接在稠密三角网格上进行路径搜索则计算代价过高。导航网格通过多边形抽象底层网格来缓解这些问题，但其假设可通行性与偏航角无关，因此不适用于受限空间中的非圆形机器人。本文提出SE(2)导航网格（SE(2) NavMesh）——一种编码偏航相关可通行性的可通行区域多边形表示方法。该方法利用足迹掩膜评估可通行性，并在具有显式平移与旋转连接关系的偏航特定层上构建图结构。基于该表示，我们开发了A*-拉绳-A*（ASA）路径搜索策略，通过层次化优化机器人位置与朝向。同时提出一种在线方法，可在并发几何重建过程中根据流式点云增量更新SE(2) NavMesh。仿真实验表明，SE(2) NavMesh比经典导航网格多捕捉50%以上的可通行区域，且SE(2) NavMesh + ASA流水线在受限环境中始终优于基于采样的基线方法。在实体机器人上的大量真实环境实验验证了实时在线生成能力及跨环境导航的成功率。
tldr: Proposes SE(2) NavMesh, a polygonal representation for ground robot navigation that encodes yaw-dependent traversability, enabling pathfinding in constrained multi-level environments with the ASA planner.
tldr_zh: 提出了SE(2)导航网格，一种编码偏航依赖可遍历性的多边形表示，用于地面机器人在受限多层环境中的路径规划，并设计了ASA规划器。

title: BIFROST: Bridging Invariant Feature Representation for Observation-space Sim2Real Transfer
summary: Sim2real transfer for robot policy learning suffers due to mismatch between simulation and reality. Existing methods typically address each gap in isolation through separate adaptation modules, which are composed or layered when both gaps coexist. Yet the basis for attempting sim2real in the first place is that there is shared structure between a task in simulation and reality, where equivalent actions from equivalent configurations produce equivalent long term outcomes regardless of domain specific differences in rendering or physics. In this paper, we study whether we can identify and exploit this shared structure from raw observations to train a policy that enables zero shot transfer. We introduce BIFROST, which learns a shared history encoder on paired cross-domain data via cross-domain bisimulation objective: observation-action sequences leading to equivalent long-term behavior are mapped to nearby latent states, regardless of domain. Policies trained on these latent states in simulation transfer zero-shot to reality. We provide empirical evidence on sim2sim visual navigation and sim2real contact rich manipulation task and visual servoing task that BIFROST achieves effective transfer where domain adaptation and co-training baselines fail under both visual and dynamics domain gaps.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
基于仿真到现实迁移的机器人策略学习因仿真与现实之间的差异而受到影响。现有方法通常通过独立的适配模块分别应对每种差异，当两种差异同时存在时将这些模块组合或分层使用。然而，开展仿真到现实迁移的首要前提是：仿真与现实中的任务存在共享结构，即无论渲染或物理层面的领域差异如何，来自等价构型的等价动作都能产生等价的长期结果。本文研究能否从原始观测中识别并利用这种共享结构，以训练出支持零样本迁移的策略。我们提出BIFROST方法，通过跨域双模拟目标函数在配对跨域数据上学习共享历史编码器：将能导致等价长期行为的动作-观测序列映射到邻近的潜在状态，而不受领域限制。基于这些潜在状态在仿真中训练的策略可直接零样本迁移至现实。我们在仿真到仿真的视觉导航、仿真到现实的接触丰富型操作任务以及视觉伺服任务中提供了实证证据，表明BIFROST在视觉与动态领域差异同时存在时能实现有效迁移，而领域适配与协同训练基线方法则无法成功。
tldr: BIFROST learns a shared latent representation from paired sim-real observation-action sequences via cross-domain bisimulation, enabling zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for robot policies.
tldr_zh: BIFROST通过跨域双模拟目标从配对的仿真-真实观测-动作序列中学习共享潜在表示，实现机器人策略的零样本仿真到现实迁移。

title: Repair the Amplifier, Not the Symptom: Stable World-Model Correction for Agent Rollouts
summary: As agent planning moves from short tool chains toward persistent workflows with thousands or tens of thousands of steps, failures will occur inside large planning graphs rather than in isolated predictions. Replanning the entire graph after every mistake is neither computationally realistic nor desirable: full-graph replay consumes large context budgets, exposes the LLM to many irrelevant symptoms, and can degrade long-context retrieval. This paper studies the missing component in such systems: a world-model corrector that repairs the failed planning graph in place. We compare two families of correctors. The first is the common engineering approach: scan nodes and edges, choose a suspicious local region, and ask an LLM to repair it. We implement strong engineering LLM correctors and find that they can help, especially when given very large contexts. The second family is our approach, WM-SAR (World-Model Subgraph Amplification Repair): instead of scanning for visible symptoms, it works backward from subgraph amplification, identifies the nodes and edges that keep re-amplifying error, and sends only that causal subgraph to the LLM. Across graph simulations and LLM repair experiments, WM-SAR substantially outperforms engineering correctors under realistic token budgets, achieves near-whole-graph stabilization with a compact region, and gives the LLM a cleaner repair target.
summary_zh: 摘要：随着智能体规划从短工具链转向包含数千乃至数万个步骤的持久化工作流，失败将发生在大型规划图内部，而非孤立的预测中。在每次错误后对整个图进行重规划既非计算上的现实选择，也不可取：全图重放会消耗大量上下文预算，使大语言模型暴露于许多无关症状中，并可能降低长上下文检索能力。本文研究了此类系统中缺失的组件：一种能够原位修复失败规划图的世界模型修正器。我们比较了两类修正器。第一类是常见的工程方法：扫描节点和边，选择可疑的局部区域，并让大语言模型进行修复。我们实现了强大的工程化大语言模型修正器，并发现它们能够发挥作用，尤其是在给予非常大的上下文时。第二类是我们的方法——WM-SAR（世界模型子图放大修复）：它不扫描可见症状，而是从子图放大逆向工作，识别持续放大误差的节点和边，仅将该因果子图发送给大语言模型。通过图模拟和大语言模型修复实验，WM-SAR在现实的令牌预算下显著优于工程化修正器，能以紧凑区域实现接近全图稳定的效果，并为大语言模型提供更清晰的修复目标。
tldr: This paper introduces WM-SAR, a world-model corrector that repairs planning graphs by identifying and patching the causal subgraph responsible for error amplification, outperforming standard LLM-based symptom-driven repair under realistic token budgets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出WM-SAR，一种世界模型修正器，通过识别并修补导致错误放大的因果子图来修复规划图，在现实token预算下优于标准LLM症状驱动式修复。

title: Search-based Testing of Vision Language Models for In-Car Scene Understanding
summary: In the automotive domain, in-car scene understanding (ISU) enables the detection of safety-critical events, such as driver distraction, and supports drivers or passengers by analyzing the in-car scene and adapting the environment (e.g., ambient lighting). The industry is increasingly exploring vision-language models (VLMs) to interpret camera-recorded in-car scenes and extract information for downstream reasoning tasks. However, VLMs may generate incomplete, erroneous, or misleading scene descriptions, highlighting the need for systematic testing. Collecting real in-vehicle data is costly, difficult to scale, and often infeasible, particularly in early design stages. In this paper, we present ISU-Test, an automated testing approach that combines rendering-based scene generation with search-based testing to evaluate ISU systems. By framing testing as an optimization problem and systematically modifying scene parameters, our method generates diverse in-car scenarios and explores a wide range of configurations. We evaluate ISU-Test on both an industrial prototype and open-source VLMs across two case studies: question answering and captioning, comparing against randomized scenario generation. Results show that ISU-Test significantly outperforms the baseline, achieving up to 10 times higher failure rates and up to 3.6 times higher failure coverage.
summary_zh: 在汽车领域，车内场景理解（ISU）能够检测诸如驾驶员分心等安全关键事件，并通过分析车内场景及调整环境（如氛围灯）为驾驶员或乘客提供支持。业界正越来越多地探索视觉语言模型（VLM）来解释摄像头记录的车内场景，并提取信息用于下游推理任务。然而，VLM可能生成不完整、错误或具有误导性的场景描述，这凸显了系统性测试的必要性。采集真实的车载数据成本高昂、难以规模化，且在早期设计阶段往往不可行。本文提出ISU-Test，一种结合基于渲染的场景生成与基于搜索的测试的自动化测试方法，用于评估ISU系统。通过将测试建模为优化问题并系统性地修改场景参数，该方法能够生成多样化的车内场景并探索广泛的配置空间。我们在一个工业原型和多个开源VLM上，针对问答和字幕生成两个案例研究进行了ISU-Test评估，并与随机化场景生成进行了对比。结果表明，ISU-Test显著优于基线方法，失败率最高提升10倍，失败覆盖率最高提升3.6倍。
tldr: This paper presents ISU-Test, an automated testing approach that combines rendering-based scene generation with search-based testing to evaluate vision-language models for in-car scene understanding, achieving up to 10x higher failure rates.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ISU-Test，一种结合渲染场景生成与搜索测试的自动化测试方法，用于评估车载场景理解的视觉语言模型，故障率提升高达10倍。

title: Comprehensive Robustness Analysis of LiDAR-based 3D Object Detection in Autonomous Driving
summary: Recent advancements in LiDAR-only 3D object detection have demonstrated improved detection accuracy over benchmark datasets. However, the adversarial robustness of these models remains untested. Very few adversarial robustness studies exist for LiDAR-only 3D object detection and unfortunately, even they are limited to legacy models. Moreover, there is a systemic gap in the existing evaluation frameworks that rely simply on mAP ignoring other structural and predictive factors. To fill this gap, we propose a holistic framework that evaluates adversarial robustness using two structural factors (point cloud density and point cloud localization) and three predictive factors (misclassification, localization error, distance from ego). Using this framework, we perform an empirical study and critical analysis on recent and legacy state-of-the-art models using adversarial attacks specifically designed for LiDAR-based models. Our key finding is that high-capacity, voxel-based detectors are more susceptible to structured coordinate perturbations than pillar-based detectors. Additionally, non-anchor-based detectors demonstrate poor adversarial robustness, which necessitates rethinking model training techniques. Overall, our results demonstrate that recent models are as vulnerable to adversarial attacks as their predecessors. Therefore, we argue that there is a need to improve the evaluation benchmarks for 3D object detection that not only reward architectural modifications for improving detection accuracy, but also evaluate whether the design choices improve adversarial robustness.
summary_zh: 近年来，仅基于LiDAR的3D物体检测技术已在基准数据集上展现出更高的检测精度。然而，这些模型的对抗鲁棒性仍未经检验。目前针对仅基于LiDAR的3D物体检测的对抗鲁棒性研究极少，且遗憾的是，这些研究也仅限于传统模型。此外，现有评估框架存在系统性缺陷——它们仅依赖mAP指标，忽略了其他结构与预测因素。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了一种整体性评估框架，该框架利用两种结构因素（点云密度与点云定位）和三种预测因素（误分类、定位误差、自车距离）来评估对抗鲁棒性。基于该框架，我们针对近期及传统的先进模型，采用专门针对LiDAR模型的对抗攻击方法开展了实证研究与批判性分析。关键发现表明：高容量体素检测器对结构化坐标扰动的敏感度高于支柱检测器；此外，非锚点检测器的对抗鲁棒性较差，这要求我们重新审视模型训练技术。总体而言，我们的结果表明：当前模型与早期模型同样易受对抗攻击。因此，我们认为有必要改进3D物体检测的评估基准，不仅要奖励提升检测精度的架构改进，还应评估设计选择是否增强了对抗鲁棒性。
tldr: This paper proposes a holistic framework to evaluate adversarial robustness of LiDAR-based 3D object detectors using structural and predictive factors, and finds that recent high-capacity models remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个综合框架，利用结构性和预测性因素评估基于LiDAR的3D目标检测器的对抗鲁棒性，并发现近期高容量模型仍易受对抗攻击。

title: PWM-ArtGen: Part World Model for Articulated Object Generation
summary: The key challenge in articulated 3D object generation from a single image is accurately predicting the underlying kinematic structure. Existing methods either infer kinematic parameters directly from a static image that lacks dynamic part-level kinematic relationships, or estimate parameters from visual dynamics generated from a single image, which is prone to accumulated errors of two steps. Moreover, the limited scale and diversity of existing annotated datasets further hinder generalization to complex, real-world objects. To overcome these limitations, we propose to learn the joint distribution of visual dynamics and kinematic parameters. Recognizing that articulated objects can be formulated as dynamic systems, we propose a unified Part World Model called PWM-ArtGen. To leverage unannotated data, this model couples action diffusion and image diffusion with independent diffusion timesteps, which enables visual branch co-training. We further curate a photorealistic dataset of 19.7k part-level image pairs without kinematic annotations, to support co-training. Experiments demonstrate that PWM-ArtGen substantially outperforms existing baselines in the resting state and exhibits strong zero-shot generalization to out-of-distribution objects.
summary_zh: 从单张图像生成铰接式3D物体的关键挑战在于准确预测潜在的运动学结构。现有方法要么直接从缺乏动态部件级运动关系的静态图像中推断运动学参数，要么从单张图像生成的视觉动态中估计参数，后者容易产生两个步骤的累积误差。此外，现有标注数据集的规模和多样性有限，进一步阻碍了对复杂真实世界物体的泛化能力。为克服这些限制，我们提出学习视觉动态与运动学参数的联合分布。考虑到铰接式物体可被建模为动态系统，我们提出一种名为PWM-ArtGen的统一部件世界模型。为利用无标注数据，该模型将动作扩散与图像扩散通过独立扩散时间步长进行耦合，从而支持视觉分支的协同训练。我们进一步构建了一个包含19.7k部件级图像对的无运动学标注逼真数据集以支持协同训练。实验表明，PWM-ArtGen在静止状态下显著优于现有基线方法，并对分布外物体展现出强大的零样本泛化能力。
tldr: This paper proposes a unified Part World Model (PWM-ArtGen) that learns the joint distribution of visual dynamics and kinematic parameters for articulated 3D object generation from a single image, enabling zero-shot generalization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种统一的部件世界模型（PWM-ArtGen），从单张图像学习视觉动态和运动学参数的联合分布，以生成铰接式3D物体，并实现零样本泛化。

title: ComplexMimic: Human-Scene Interaction Imitation in Complex 3D Environments
summary: Physics-based Human-Scene Interaction (HSI) imitation learning is crucial for embodied intelligence as it bridges the gap between kinematic 3D motions and real-world dynamics. However, most existing methods focus on simplified scene settings, leaving complex environments largely unexplored, which limits their applicability in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we focus on HSI mimicry in complex environments. Under this complex setting, we observe an inherent trade-off between successfully performing interaction and maintaining natural, physically plausible motions. To address this challenge, we propose ComplexMimic, a framework that reconstructs diverse HSI by interpreting imperfect MoCap data. First, we introduce a Dual Flow Strategy, which learns two complementary experts: an imitation expert for accurate motion tracking and an interaction expert for collision-aware adaptation in complex scenes. Second, naive multi-expert distillation, which treats all experts equally, often under-samples challenging behaviors, limiting effective learning. To mitigate this issue, we propose a difficulty-aware distillation strategy that adaptively weights supervision and prioritizes hard-yet-learnable trajectories guided by failure statistics and learning progress signals. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms current state-of-the-art methods. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/LuPan23/ComplexMimic.
summary_zh: 基于物理的人-场景交互（HSI）模仿学习对于具身智能至关重要，因为它弥合了运动学三维运动与现实世界动力学之间的差距。然而，现有方法大多聚焦于简化场景设置，复杂环境在很大程度上尚未被探索，这限制了其在真实世界场景中的适用性。本文聚焦于复杂环境中的HSI模仿。在此复杂设定下，我们观察到成功执行交互与保持自然、物理合理运动之间存在固有的权衡。为应对这一挑战，我们提出ComplexMimic框架，该框架通过解读不完美的动作捕捉数据来重建多样化的HSI。首先，我们引入双流策略，学习两个互补的专家：一个用于精确运动追踪的模仿专家，以及一个用于复杂场景中碰撞感知适应的交互专家。其次，将所有专家同等对待的朴素多专家蒸馏方法，往往对具有挑战性的行为采样不足，从而限制了有效学习。为缓解此问题，我们提出一种难度感知的蒸馏策略，该策略自适应地对监督信号进行加权，并优先处理由失败统计和学习进度信号引导的困难但可学习的轨迹。在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法优于当前最先进的方法。我们的实现代码已开源在 https://github.com/LuPan23/ComplexMimic。
tldr: ComplexMimic introduces a dual-flow strategy and difficulty-aware distillation to enable physics-based human-scene interaction imitation in complex 3D environments from imperfect MoCap data.
tldr_zh: ComplexMimic 通过双流策略和难度感知蒸馏技术，实现了在复杂 3D 环境中基于不完美动作捕捉数据的、物理合理的人-场景交互模仿。

title: C2E: Boosting Ego-Only 3D Object Detection via Multi-Teacher Contrastive Knowledge Distillation
summary: LiDAR-based 3D object detection is essential for autonomous driving systems. However, traditional Ego-only Perception (Eo-Perception) suffers from limited perspective and occlusions in a complex outdoor environment, leading to performance bottlenecks. Recently, research on multi-agent Collaborative Perception (Co-Perception) has demonstrated excellent performance, but high communication costs and accumulated pose error hinder its application. To address this, we explore a novel C2E (Co-Perception to Eo-Perception) paradigm through the Multi-to-Single (M2S) agent contrastive knowledge distillation framework. Our M2S framework first designs Multi-Level Feature Enhancement module to provide more stable features, and introduces Auxiliary Point Cloud Reconstruction and Multi-Teacher Contrastive Distillation mechanisms to mitigate domain gaps in point cloud and feature distributions within the C2E paradigm. Benefiting from this, our M2S can retain the excellent performance of collaborative perception while effectively avoiding the drawbacks, such as communication delays and positioning errors. Extensive experiments on the V2XSet, V2V4Real and DAIR-V2X datasets show the effectiveness and generalizability of our M2S framework when combined with the state-of-the-art CoSDH model and other excellent 3D detectors. Our M2S framework can deliver up to a 8.64% improvement in 3D mAP performance without introducing any communication costs.
summary_zh: 基于激光雷达的三维目标检测对自动驾驶系统至关重要。然而，在复杂室外环境中，传统的单车感知（Eo-Perception）受限于视角有限和遮挡问题，导致性能瓶颈。近年来，多智能体协同感知（Co-Perception）研究展现出优异性能，但高昂的通信开销与累积位姿误差制约了其应用。针对这一问题，我们通过多对单（M2S）智能体对比知识蒸馏框架，探索了从协同感知到单车感知（C2E）的新型范式。该M2S框架首先设计多层级特征增强模块以提供更稳定的特征，并引入辅助点云重建与多教师对比蒸馏机制，以弥合C2E范式中点云与特征分布的域差异。基于此，我们的M2S既能保留协同感知的卓越性能，又可有效规避通信延迟、定位误差等缺陷。在V2XSet、V2V4Real及DAIR-V2X数据集上的大量实验表明，M2S框架与当前最先进的CoSDH模型及其他优秀的3D检测器结合时均展现出有效性与泛化能力。该M2S框架在不引入任何通信成本的前提下，最高可提升8.64%的3D mAP性能。
tldr: This paper proposes a multi-teacher contrastive knowledge distillation framework that transfers knowledge from multi-agent collaborative perception to ego-only 3D object detection for autonomous driving, achieving performance gains without communication costs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种多教师对比知识蒸馏框架，将多智能体协同感知的知识迁移到仅自车3D目标检测中，在自动驾驶场景下无需通信成本即可提升性能。

title: LLM-Empowered Multimodal Fusion Framework for Autonomous Driving: Semantic Enhancement and Channel-Adaptive Design
summary: Vision-radar fusion is central to robust autonomous driving, combining dense visual semantics with precise range and velocity measurements from radar. However, real-world fusion quality is fundamentally challenged by dynamically varying input quality, stemming from occlusion, adverse weather, and channel noise. To address this, we re-frame the problem from static data fusion to channel-aware semantic reasoning and propose a Large Language Model-centric Semantic-layer Channel-aware Integrated Perception (LM-SCIP) framework. It places a Large Language Model (LLM) as a central reasoning core to fuse a local visual stream with a quality-varying external radar stream used to cover perception-blind spots. Concretely, LM-SCIP couples a hierarchical radar-vision encoder with a Channel-Adaptive Semantic Module (CASM) that maps link indicators into a "Channel Prompt" to dynamically gate external radar features. A parameter-efficient, LoRA-tuned LLM, in conjunction with a heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts (H-MoE), then arbitrates between local visual cues and the channel-conditioned radar context. Finally, a decoupled multi-task decoder outputs localization, trajectory forecasting, and image reconstruction. Experiments on nuScenes and VIRAT validate our approach. On nuScenes, under a controlled toggle of radar input, LM-SCIP reduces localization RMSE by 40.0% versus a vision-only baseline. On VIRAT, the model attains a 0.214m localization RMSE and 0.179m minFDE (k=1). These results reveal that the proposed LM-SCIP enables a robust vision-dominant fallback at low SNR and synergistic fusion at high SNR.
summary_zh: 视觉-雷达融合是实现鲁棒自动驾驶的核心，它将密集的视觉语义信息与雷达提供的精确距离和速度测量相结合。然而，实际场景中的融合质量从根本上受到动态变化的输入质量的挑战，这些变化源于遮挡、恶劣天气和信道噪声。为解决此问题，我们将问题从静态数据融合重新定义为信道感知语义推理，并提出了一种以大语言模型为中心的语义层信道感知集成感知（LM-SCIP）框架。该框架将大语言模型（LLM）作为核心推理中枢，融合本地视觉流与用于覆盖感知盲区的质量动态变化的外部雷达流。具体而言，LM-SCIP将分层雷达-视觉编码器与信道自适应语义模块（CASM）相耦合，该模块将链路指标映射为“信道提示”，以动态门控外部雷达特征。一个参数高效的、经LoRA微调的LLM，结合异构混合专家模型（H-MoE），对本地视觉线索与信道条件依赖的雷达上下文进行仲裁。最后，解耦的多任务解码器输出定位、轨迹预测和图像重建结果。在nuScenes和VIRAT数据集上的实验验证了我们的方法。在nuScenes上，通过可控的雷达输入切换，LM-SCIP相较于纯视觉基线将定位均方根误差（RMSE）降低了40.0%。在VIRAT上，模型实现了0.214米的定位RMSE和0.179米的最小最终位移误差（minFDE，k=1）。这些结果表明，所提出的LM-SCIP能够在低信噪比下实现稳健的视觉主导降级，并在高信噪比下实现协同融合。
tldr: Proposes an LLM-centric fusion framework for autonomous driving that uses channel-aware semantic gating and LoRA-tuned LLM reasoning to adaptively fuse vision and radar streams, demonstrating robust performance under varying sensor quality.
tldr_zh: 提出一个以LLM为中心的自动驾驶融合框架，通过信道感知语义门控和LoRA微调的LLM推理，自适应融合视觉与雷达流，在传感器质量变化时展现鲁棒性能。

title: Certified World Models as Sensing Clocks: Drift-Aware Deadlines for Active Perception
summary: Certified world models estimate how long their predictions remain valid. We turn this validity horizon into an operational sensing clock: a rule for when an agent should stop coasting and re-sense. Starting from an audited equivariant world model, we derive a deadline for no-sensing intervals and show that deployable deadlines in learned world models must be drift-aware: on-manifold Lyapunov rates alone overestimate coasting validity, while calibrated native rollout-drift envelopes carry the deployed guarantee. On a frozen 3D VN-JEPA model, the resulting clock controls held-out interval-simultaneous certificate violation across seeds and data shards. In a cue-conditioned theorem-bed (a synthetic bench where all schedulers share the exact model, isolating the scheduling rule), the clock remains valid on the deployment distribution and substantially reduces eventful-tail violations relative to exact-mixture expected-belief scheduling at matched sensing budget. We also report limits: in the short-horizon frozen VN-JEPA regime, empirical conformal horizons match the deployed clock on validity and budget, and a partial-reset exploration finds no clean budget-matched advantage for the spectral term. Thus the contribution is a certified sensing-clock primitive and drift-aware deployment method, not a claim that spectral clocks empirically dominate all non-spectral schedulers.
summary_zh: 经认证的世界模型能够估计其预测结果的有效时长。我们将这一有效性时域转化为一个可操作的感知时钟：即一个规则，用以决定智能体何时应停止惯性运行并重新进行感知。基于一个经过审计的等变世界模型，我们推导出了无感知间隔的截止时间，并表明在经学习的世界模型中，可部署的截止时间必须是对漂移敏感的：仅依靠流形上的李雅普诺夫速率会高估惯性运行的有效性，而经过校准的原生展开漂移包络则携带了部署保证。在冻结的3D VN-JEPA模型上，由此产生的时钟能够控制跨随机种子与数据分片的、保留测试间隔的联合违规行为。在一个线索条件化的定理实验台（一个合成基准平台，其中所有调度器共享同一精确模型，从而隔离调度规则）上，该时钟在部署分布中保持有效，并且在匹配的感知预算下，相较于精确混合期望信念调度，显著减少了事件尾部的违规情况。我们也报告了其局限性：在短视界冻结VN-JEPA机制下，经验共形时域在有效性与预算方面与部署时钟相匹配，而部分重置探索并未发现谱项具有明显的预算匹配优势。因此，本研究的贡献在于提出了一种经过认证的感知时钟原语与对漂移敏感的部署方法，而非主张谱时钟在经验上优于所有非谱调度器。
tldr: This paper introduces a certified sensing-clock primitive that uses drift-aware deadlines from a world model to determine when an agent should re-sense, providing a deployed guarantee that on-manifold Lyapunov rates alone cannot offer.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种经过认证的感知时钟原语，利用来自世界模型的漂移感知截止时间来决定智能体何时应重新感知，并提供了部署保证，而单独的流形 Lyapunov 率无法提供这种保证。

title: Learning Agile Intruder Interception using Differentiable Quadrotor Dynamics
summary: This paper presents a methodology for learning a control policy to intercept an intruder using the 3D direction unit vector to the intruder and the interceptor state. Prior deep reinforcement learning approaches assume either relative position or distance to the intruder is available, but this information is not readily accessible in real-world applications that employ passive, monocular camera sensors. Instead, we propose a solution that leverages an analytical policy gradient method using differentiable quadrotor dynamics to learn agile interception at speeds up to 10 m/s. The proposed approach outperforms baseline methods that utilize simplified point mass dynamics by an average of 30%.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种利用拦截器状态及指向入侵者的三维方向单位矢量来学习拦截控制策略的方法。现有深度强化学习方法假设可获取与入侵者的相对位置或距离，但在采用被动单目相机传感器的实际应用中，这类信息难以直接获取。为此，我们提出一种基于可微四旋翼动力学的解析策略梯度方法，使飞行器能够以高达10米/秒的速度实现敏捷拦截。与采用简化质点动力学的基线方法相比，本方法平均性能提升30%。
tldr: Uses differentiable quadrotor dynamics and analytical policy gradients to learn an agile intruder interception policy that relies only on 3D direction vectors (compatible with monocular cameras), outperforming point-mass baselines by 30%.
tldr_zh: 利用可微四旋翼动力学和分析策略梯度方法，学习仅依赖3D方向向量（兼容单目相机）的敏捷入侵拦截策略，性能比点质量基线方法平均提升30%。

title: NEUROSYMLAND: Neuro-Symbolic Landing-Site Assessment for Robust and Edge-Deployable UAV Autonomy
summary: Safe landing-site assessment in unstructured environments remains a key challenge for autonomous UAV deployment, as vision-only learning approaches often degrade under terrain variability and provide limited transparency in safety decisions. We present NEUROSYMLAND, a neuro-symbolic landing-site assessment system that integrates lightweight perception with explicit safety reasoning. The framework constructs a probabilistic semantic scene graph from onboard visual input and evaluates candidate landing regions using symbolic constraints capturing terrain flatness, obstacle clearance, and spatial consistency, enabling structured reasoning under perceptual uncertainty while maintaining edge-feasible execution. Across 72 simulated landing scenarios spanning diverse terrains, NEUROSYMLAND achieves 61 successful assessments, outperforming four competitive baselines (37-57 successes). To evaluate deployability, we further conduct 100 hardware-in-the-loop trials with randomized initial poses, profiling end-to-end latency, stage-wise execution time, and system-level metrics including CPU/GPU utilization, memory footprint, and power consumption. Results demonstrate improved robustness and interpretability with bounded edge-resource usage. Profiling shows that symbolic reasoning contributes only a small fraction of end-to-end latency, while the main computational cost arises from perception and PSSG construction. These results demonstrate the feasibility of deploying the landing-site assessment stack on edge-constrained UAV hardware, and all source code, datasets, prompts, and symbolic rule refinement examples are released in an open-source repository
summary_zh: 在非结构化环境中进行安全着陆点评估，仍是自主无人机部署面临的关键挑战，因为纯视觉学习方法常因地形变化而性能下降，且在安全决策方面透明度有限。我们提出NEUROSYMLAND，一种融合轻量级感知与显式安全推理的神经符号着陆点评估系统。该系统从机载视觉输入构建概率语义场景图，并利用捕捉地形平坦度、障碍物净空和空间一致性的符号化约束条件评估候选着陆区域，从而在感知不确定性下实现结构化推理，同时保持边缘端可行执行。在覆盖多种地形的72个模拟着陆场景中，NEUROSYMLAND成功完成61次评估，优于四种基准方法（37-57次成功）。为评估部署可行性，我们进一步进行了100次硬件在环试验，采用随机初始位姿，分析端到端延迟、阶段执行时间以及CPU/GPU利用率、内存占用和功耗等系统级指标。结果表明，该方法在边缘资源受限条件下提升了鲁棒性和可解释性。性能分析显示，符号推理仅占端到端延迟的很小部分，主要计算开销来自感知和概率语义场景图构建。这些结果验证了在边缘受限无人机硬件上部署着陆点评估堆栈的可行性，所有源代码、数据集、提示词和符号规则优化示例均已开源发布。
tldr: NEUROSYMLAND combines lightweight perception with symbolic reasoning for safe UAV landing-site assessment, demonstrating robustness and edge-deployability in simulated and hardware-in-the-loop trials.
tldr_zh: NEUROSYMLAND 结合轻量级感知与符号推理来实现安全的无人机着陆点评估，并在仿真和硬件在环实验中展示了鲁棒性和边缘可部署性。

title: Influence of Radial Basis Activation Functions on Intelligent Controller for Robotic Manipulators
summary: This paper presents an intelligent control framework for trajectory tracking of robotic manipulators using radial basis function (RBF) neural networks for online disturbance estimation. The proposed control structure combines model-based nonlinear control with an adaptive neural approximator that compensates for parametric uncertainties, friction, and unmodeled dynamics. A Lyapunov-based adaptation law with projection guarantees boundedness of the closed-loop signals and convergence of the tracking error to a compact region. The primary objective of this work is to investigate how the choice of activation function within the RBF network influences transient behavior, steady-state accuracy, and control smoothness. The controller is implemented on a robotic manipulator. Experimental results demonstrate that although stability is preserved for all kernels, activation function selection significantly affects adaptation dynamics and practical tracking performance. These findings demonstrate that activation function selection acts as a structural design parameter in intelligent control, directly shaping adaptation dynamics and practical closed-loop performance.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于径向基函数（RBF）神经网络在线扰动估计的机器人机械臂轨迹跟踪智能控制框架。该控制结构将基于模型非线性控制与自适应神经逼近器相结合，以补偿参数不确定性、摩擦及未建模动态。基于Lyapunov方法的投影修正律保证了闭环信号的有界性以及跟踪误差收敛至紧致区域。本研究的主要目标在于探究RBF网络中激活函数的选择如何影响暂态响应、稳态精度及控制平滑性。该控制器已在机器人机械臂上实现。实验结果表明，虽然所有核函数均能保持系统稳定性，但激活函数的选择会显著影响自适应动力学特性及实际跟踪性能。这些发现表明，激活函数选择作为智能控制中的结构设计参数，直接影响自适应动力学特性与闭环实际性能。
tldr: This paper investigates how the choice of radial basis function activation affects the performance of an adaptive neural controller for robotic manipulator trajectory tracking, finding that activation selection significantly influences transient and steady-state behavior.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了径向基函数激活函数的选择如何影响用于机器人机械臂轨迹跟踪的自适应神经控制器的性能，发现激活函数选择显著影响暂态和稳态行为。

title: Lightweight Safe Reinforcement Learning for End-to-End UAV Navigation
summary: With the rapid development of autonomous aerial systems, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly deployed in applications such as inspection, environmental monitoring, and rescue, creating growing demand for reliable autonomous navigation. However, autonomous UAV navigation in dense environments remains challenging under sparse perception and dynamic constraints. Most reinforcement learning (RL) methods lack explicit safety mechanisms, leading to unsafe exploration, unstable training, and risky behaviors, especially during high-speed flight. Even in safe RL approaches, safety is often enforced by projecting policy outputs onto a safe action set, which may introduce instability. Meanwhile, many learning-based methods rely on dense inputs or large networks, increasing computational burden and limiting lightweight onboard deployment. Facing the above challenges, we propose a safety-constrained perception-control integrated framework for UAV navigation. A lightweight network encodes sparse observations into collision-risk-aware features using asymmetric and depthwise separable convolutions. We formulate the task as a constrained Markov decision process within a hierarchical control architecture and solve it using a Lagrangian-based safe PPO algorithm. Curriculum learning further improves training stability. Experiments with varying obstacle densities and flight speeds demonstrate higher success rates, improved safety, and better efficiency than existing reinforcement learning baselines.
summary_zh: 随着自主空中系统的快速发展，无人机日益广泛应用于巡检、环境监测和救援等场景，对可靠自主导航的需求持续增长。然而，在稀疏感知与动态约束条件下，密集环境中的无人机自主导航仍面临挑战。大多数强化学习方法缺乏显式安全机制，导致探索过程不安全、训练不稳定及危险行为频发，尤其在高速飞行场景下。即便在安全强化学习方法中，常通过将策略输出投影至安全动作集来保障安全性，但这可能引发系统不稳定性。此外，诸多基于学习的方法依赖密集输入或大型网络，增加计算负担并限制轻量化机载部署。针对上述挑战，我们提出了一种安全约束感知-控制融合的无人机导航框架。该框架采用轻量级网络，通过非对称深度可分离卷积将稀疏观测编码为碰撞风险感知特征。我们将任务建模为层次化控制架构下的约束马尔可夫决策过程，并采用基于拉格朗日法的安全PPO算法求解。课程学习策略进一步提升了训练稳定性。在变密度障碍物与不同飞行速度下的实验表明，相较于现有强化学习基线方法，本方法在成功率、安全性和效率方面均表现更优。
tldr: A safety-constrained perception-control framework for UAV navigation using lightweight networks and safe reinforcement learning, improving success rates and safety in dense environments.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于无人机导航的安全约束感知控制框架，采用轻量级网络和安全强化学习，在密集环境中提高了成功率和安全性。

title: DL-VINS-Factory: A Modular Framework for Learned Visual Front-Ends in Visual-Inertial SLAM
summary: Deep-learning features excel in visual matching, yet their practical value in tightly coupled visual-inertial SLAM (VI-SLAM) remains insufficiently characterized. We present DL-VINS-Factory, a unified framework that integrates learned feature extractors (ALIKED, RaCo, SuperPoint, XFeat) with either Lucas--Kanade (LK) optical-flow tracking or LightGlue (LG) descriptor matching. All front-ends share a sliding-window Ceres back-end, with optional AnyLoc DINOv2-VLAD loop closure, and 4-DoF pose-graph optimization. We benchmark the system across the four datasets covering indoor, unstructured outdoor, aggressive-motion, and visually degraded conditions. Results show that learned front-ends are viable for real-time embedded VI-SLAM, but are not universally superior to classical tracking. Relative to the corresponding GFTT+LK baseline, ALIKED+LG reduces EuRoC ATE by $5\%$ in monocular odometry and by $7\%$ in stereo with loop-closure. On NTU-VIRAL, where aggressive aerial motion increases inter-frame viewpoint change, ALIKED+LG stereo reduces loop-closed ATE by $12\%$. In Botanic Garden dataset, optical-flow tracking remains preferable, but learned keypoints still improve over the baseline GFTT, in which SuperPoint+LK reduces grayscale camera ATE by $29\%$, while RaCo+LK reduces RGB camera ATE by $38\%$. On SubT-MRS, learned front-ends display varying degree of improvement based on individual cases. With TensorRT acceleration on a Jetson AGX Orin, all valid configurations run in real time between $29$--$47$ FPS in monocular mode and $18$--$33$ FPS in stereo mode for the EuRoC and NTU-VIRAL datasets. AnyLoc further confirms roughly $2$--$7\times$ more valid loops than BRIEF+DBoW2. The implementation is open-sourced at https://github.com/limshoonkit/DL-VINS-Factory-ROS2/.
summary_zh: 深度学习特征在视觉匹配中表现出色，但其在紧耦合视觉-惯性SLAM（VI-SLAM）中的实用价值尚未得到充分表征。我们提出DL-VINS-Factory，一个统一框架，将学习型特征提取器（ALIKED、RaCo、SuperPoint、XFeat）与Lucas-Kanade（LK）光流跟踪或LightGlue（LG）描述子匹配相结合。所有前端共享滑动窗口Ceres后端，并可选配AnyLoc DINOv2-VLAD闭环检测及4自由度位姿图优化。我们在涵盖室内、非结构化户外、剧烈运动及视觉退化条件的四个数据集上对系统进行基准测试。结果表明，学习型前端可用于实时嵌入式VI-SLAM，但并非普遍优于经典跟踪。相较于对应的GFTT+LK基线，ALIKED+LG在单目里程计中使EuRoC ATE降低5%，在带闭环的立体模式下降低7%。在NTU-VIRAL数据集上，由于剧烈空中运动导致帧间视角变化增大，ALIKED+LG立体模式使带闭环的ATE降低12%。在Botanic Garden数据集中，光流跟踪仍具优势，但学习型关键点仍优于基线GFTT——其中SuperPoint+LK使灰度相机ATE降低29%，而RaCo+LK使RGB相机ATE降低38%。在SubT-MRS上，学习型前端根据具体案例呈现不同程度的改进。在Jetson AGX Orin上采用TensorRT加速后，对于EuRoC和NTU-VIRAL数据集，所有有效配置在单目模式下均以29-47 FPS实时运行，立体模式下为18-33 FPS。AnyLoc进一步证实其有效闭环数量比BRIEF+DBoW2多约2-7倍。相关实现已开源：https://github.com/limshoonkit/DL-VINS-Factory-ROS2/。
tldr: DL-VINS-Factory is a modular framework integrating various learned visual front-ends into visual-inertial SLAM, benchmarking their performance on diverse datasets and demonstrating real-time embedded viability with TensorRT acceleration.
tldr_zh: DL-VINS-Factory是一个模块化框架，将多种学习型视觉前端集成到视觉惯性SLAM中，在多个数据集上评估其性能，并通过TensorRT加速证明了其实时嵌入式可行性。

title: OPINE-World: Programmatic World Modeling with Ontology-error-Prioritized Interactive Exploration
summary: Learning how an environment behaves from interaction is central to building agents that adapt to unfamiliar tasks. World models learned with deep networks are flexible but data-hungry and transfer poorly beyond their training distribution. Program-synthesized world models, written as source code by LLMs and refined through counterexample-guided inductive synthesis (CEGIS), are instead data-efficient and reusable, yet they have been demonstrated mainly on structured-state worlds with a given object vocabulary, and a single program search does not scale to pixel-rendered environments whose object structure must be hypothesized flexibly. We introduce OPINE-World, an LLM agent that learns an object-centric programmatic world model online from interaction. OPINE-World couples two cooperating agents in a loop of hypothesis and test, one acting in the environment and one synthesizing the model in code with replay verification and model-based planning, and it steers exploration with a Bayesian measure of object-type adequacy we call ontology error. We evaluate OPINE-World on ARC-AGI-3, a benchmark for skill-acquisition efficiency in which the object vocabulary, the goal, and the action semantics are withheld. OPINE-World solves 20 of 25 games without per-game training and reaches an action-efficiency score of 78.4 against the human baseline.
summary_zh: 从交互中学习环境的行为模式，是构建能够适应陌生任务的智能体的核心。基于深度网络学习的世界模型虽然灵活，但数据需求量大且难以泛化至训练分布之外。由大语言模型编写为源代码、并通过反例引导归纳式合成（CEGIS）优化得到的程序化世界模型，则兼具数据高效性和可复用性——然而这类方法此前主要应用于具备给定对象词汇表的结构化状态世界，且单次程序搜索无法扩展到需要灵活假设对象结构的像素渲染环境。我们提出OPINE-World，一种通过在线交互学习以对象为中心的编程世界模型的大语言模型智能体。OPINE-World将假设-验证循环中的两个协作智能体耦合：一个在环境中行动，另一个通过重放验证和基于模型的规划以代码形式合成模型，并利用我们称为本体论误差的对象类型充分性贝叶斯度量引导探索。我们在ARC-AGI-3基准上评估OPINE-World——该基准专门测试技能获取效率，其对象词汇表、目标和动作语义均被隐去。OPINE-World在无需逐游戏训练的情况下解决了25个游戏中的20个，并以78.4的动作效率分数达到人类基线水平。
tldr: OPINE-World introduces an LLM-based agent that learns object-centric programmatic world models online via interactive exploration, using ontology-error-prioritized exploration and counterexample-guided synthesis to achieve efficient skill acquisition on ARC-AGI-3 benchmark without per-game training.
tldr_zh: OPINE-World 提出了一种基于 LLM 的智能体，通过交互式探索在线学习以对象为中心的程序化世界模型，利用本体错误优先的探索和反例引导合成，在 ARC-AGI-3 基准上无需逐游戏训练即可实现高效的技能获取。

title: Bridging 3D Gaussians and Semantic Occupancy for Comprehensive Open-Vocabulary Scene Understanding from Unposed Images
summary: Comprehensive 3D scene understanding from sparse, unposed images requires a model to recover renderable geometry, open-vocabulary semantics, and free/occupied 3D space without relying on external camera calibration. Recent feed-forward Gaussian methods improve pose-free reconstruction and semantic rendering, but their Gaussian primitives are mainly optimized through image-space objectives and remain weakly constrained in unobserved regions. We propose \textit{COVScene}, a pose-free semantic Gaussian framework that couples renderable Gaussian primitives with a dense semantic occupancy field through differentiable volumetric lifting. Instead of converting Gaussians to voxels only at evaluation time, COVScene lifts the predicted semantic Gaussians inside the training computation graph, so volumetric regularization provides gradients to Gaussian opacity, geometry, and semantic features. The framework combines a semantic-aware Geometry Transformer, multi-task Gaussian decoding, geometric foundation distillation, and occupancy entropy regularization to support novel view synthesis, open-vocabulary semantic querying, and semantic occupancy prediction within a single representation. Experiments on ScanNet and ScanNet++ show that COVScene maintains competitive rendering quality, improves open-vocabulary segmentation, and achieves stronger semantic occupancy prediction than the self-supervised baseline without direct voxel-level supervision.
summary_zh: 从稀疏、无位姿图像中进行全方位3D场景理解，要求模型能够在无需外部相机标定的情况下，恢复可渲染的几何结构、开放词汇语义以及自由/占据的3D空间。近期基于前馈高斯的方法改善了无位姿重建和语义渲染的性能，但其高斯基元主要通过图像空间目标函数进行优化，在未观测区域中约束较弱。我们提出\textit{COVScene}——一种无位姿语义高斯框架，通过可微体素提拉操作将可渲染的高斯基元与密集语义占据场耦合。COVScene并非仅在评估时将高斯体素化，而是在训练计算图内部对预测的语义高斯进行提拉，使得体素正则化能够为高斯不透明度、几何结构和语义特征提供梯度。该框架结合了语义感知几何变换器、多任务高斯解码、几何基础模型蒸馏以及占据熵正则化，从而在单一表示中支持新视角合成、开放词汇语义查询和语义占据预测。在ScanNet和ScanNet++上的实验表明，COVScene在保持竞争性渲染质量的同时，改进了开放词汇分割性能，并且在无需直接体素级监督的情况下，实现了比自监督基线更强的语义占据预测能力。
tldr: COVScene couples 3D Gaussians with a semantic occupancy field for open-vocabulary scene understanding from unposed images, enabling novel view synthesis, semantic querying, and occupancy prediction.
tldr_zh: COVScene 将 3D 高斯与语义占据场结合，从无位姿图像实现开放词汇场景理解，支持新视角合成、语义查询和占据预测。

title: A Stereo Visual SLAM System Using Object-Level Motion Estimation and Geometric Filtering Based on Cross Disparity
summary: This paper presents OCD SLAM, a dynamic stereo visual SLAM framework that extends ORB-SLAM2 by jointly addressing dynamic objects and dynamic features in the scene. Usual visual SLAM systems operating in dynamic environments often fail in the presence of moving objects, due to the static-world assumption used in pose estimation and mapping. To address this predicament, we introduce a novel geometric approach based on the discrepancy between disparity and a newly proposed notion called ``cross disparity'', which exploits both temporal and stereo inconsistency to identify dynamic feature points. Complementary to this feature-level motion analysis, OCD SLAM integrates a 3D object detection module (SMOKE) with Kalman filter-based object tracking to perform object-level motion classification, enabling robust separation of static and dynamic scene elements for accurate pose estimation. The proposed approach has been evaluated on various sequences from the KITTI Odometry and KITTI Raw datasets. Results demonstrate that OCD SLAM achieves significant improvement in trajectory accuracy compared to ORB-SLAM2 and several state-of-the-art dynamic SLAM methods. Ablation studies further demonstrate the effectiveness of the cross disparity module in the KITTI Raw dataset and show that this method is able to detect dynamic features that are missed by the 3D object detection scheme alone.
tldr: This paper introduces OCD SLAM, a dynamic stereo visual SLAM system that enhances ORB-SLAM2 by using cross-disparity geometric filtering and 3D object detection to handle dynamic scenes, improving trajectory accuracy on KITTI datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出OCD SLAM，一种动态立体视觉SLAM系统，通过交叉视差几何滤波和3D目标检测改进ORB-SLAM2以处理动态场景，在KITTI数据集上提升了轨迹精度。

title: Robust Image Processing Techniques for Construction Environment Monitoring Using Underwater Robots
summary: This paper proposes a robust image processing framework for underwater robot-based construction environment monitoring, targeting complex degradations observed in real marine environments. Unlike conventional approaches that mainly consider absorption and backscattering, real underwater imagery is strongly affected by depth-dependent forward scattering blur and particle-induced degradations such as marine snow. To address this, we introduce a staged processing pipeline that sequentially models background degradation via depth-aware forward scattering and foreground degradation using realistic marine snow patterns extracted from real images. The resulting synthetic data are used to retrain an existing Joint-ID network without modifying its architecture, enabling an isolated evaluation of dataset realism. In addition, a lightweight post-processing scheme is applied to enhance contrast and structural clarity. Experiments on real underwater datasets collected in Korean coastal environments demonstrate consistent improvements in visual quality and UIQM scores. The results indicate that explicitly modeling forward scattering and realistic particle effects effectively reduces the synthetic-to-real gap and improves practical applicability in real-world underwater robotic operations.
tldr: A staged image processing pipeline that models forward scattering and marine snow to generate synthetic underwater data, improving visual quality for construction environment monitoring with underwater robots.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种分阶段图像处理流程，模拟前向散射和海洋雪以生成合成水下数据，提升了水下机器人施工环境监测的视觉质量。

title: DL-SLAM: Enabling High-Fidelity Gaussian Splatting SLAM in Dynamic Environments based on Dual-Level Probability
summary: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have enabled significant progress in dense dynamic Simultaneous Localization And Mapping (SLAM). Prevailing methods typically discard predefined dynamic objects, ignoring that transiently static objects offer valuable geometric constraints for pose estimation. A recent work attempts to leverage this potential by employing per-pixel uncertainty maps to quantify the magnitude of motion. While this approach enables transiently static objects to enhance pose estimation, it erroneously integrates these objects into the static map, resulting in persistent artifacts. Moreover, its reliance on purely geometric information leads to ambiguous object boundaries in the uncertainty maps. To overcome these limitations, we present DL-SLAM, a monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM system built upon a novel dual-level probabilistic framework. Our method computes dynamic probability maps by combining semantic and geometric information. These pixel-level probabilities are lifted to 3D and aggregated to derive an object-level dynamic probability for each instance. Object-level probability enables the categorical pruning of dynamic Gaussians, resulting in an artifact-free static map. The static map, in turn, provides a geometrically consistent guidance to refine the pixel-wise probabilities, enhancing their reliability. Experimental results demonstrate that DL-SLAM outperforms existing approaches, improving tracking accuracy by up to 13\% while generating high-fidelity semantic maps.
tldr: DL-SLAM presents a monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM system with a dual-level probabilistic framework that combines semantic and geometric information to separate dynamic objects from static ones, improving tracking accuracy up to 13% while generating artifact-free static maps.
tldr_zh: DL-SLAM提出了一种基于双层次概率框架的单目高斯溅射SLAM系统，结合语义和几何信息区分动态与静态物体，将跟踪精度提升高达13%，同时生成无伪影的静态地图。

title: Predicting Closed-Loop Performance of Latent World Models: Offline Checkpoint Selection for MPC and Model-Based RL Under Non-Markovian Rewards in LunarLander
summary: We study how to predict the downstream closed-loop performance of a learned latent world model from validation-time diagnostics alone. Choosing the right checkpoint from a world-model training run is difficult: validation loss and multi-step prediction RMSE keep improving long after closed-loop performance has collapsed. We present a suite of structural validation-time diagnostics drawn from optimal-control theory and apply them to Gymnasium's LunarLander v3, which features shaped rewards. We train an RSSM [5, 4] world model on it and treat per checkpoint CEM-MPC return as the oracle for closed-loop quality. By evaluating 40 metrics against this oracle, we find that the strongest single predictor is the Reward Observability Fraction (ROF), which measures the reward predictor's dependence on the observable subspace. We combine ROF with three structural regularizers into a single-number offline checkpoint selection score, the Composite Reward Observability Fraction (CROF). The CROF-selected world model trains a model-based A2C policy that beats a fairly evaluated model-free A2C baseline by ~24.5 return points while using ~65x fewer real-environment interactions, and the same world model also drives a strong zero-shot CEM-MPC policy. Code and data: https://github.com/nsmoly/LunarLander_RSSM.
tldr: This paper proposes a suite of structural validation-time diagnostics, including the Reward Observability Fraction (ROF), to predict the downstream closed-loop performance of latent world models, and introduces the Composite Reward Observability Fraction (CROF) for offline checkpoint selection. On LunarLander, CROF-selected world models achieve strong CEM-MPC and model-based RL policies with significantly fewer real-environment interactions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一套结构化的验证时诊断指标（包括奖励可观察性分数ROF）来预测潜世界模型的下游闭环性能，并引入了复合奖励可观察性分数（CROF）用于离线检查点选择。在LunarLander上，CROF选择的潜世界模型实现了强大的CEM-MPC和基于模型的强化学习策略，同时大幅减少了真实环境交互次数。

title: Hardware-Enforced Semantic Coordination for Safety-Critical Real-Time Autonomous Systems
summary:
Recent advances in agentic AI are producing increasingly complex autonomous systems that integrate large language models, world models, optimization engines, specialized neural architectures, autonomous platforms, and human operators. While much current research focuses on improving reasoning capabilities, safety-critical real-time deployment also requires bounded and verifiable coordination among heterogeneous components operating concurrently under uncertainty. Software-mediated coordination presents fundamental limitations in domains where bounded latency, deterministic coordination, and enforceable safety guarantees are essential.
  Hence, we propose a hardware-enforced semantic coordination architecture in which selected coordination semantics are implemented directly at the hardware level via field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs). The approach builds on the Topic-Based Communication Space Petri Net (TB-CSPN) framework, which separates semantic reasoning from interaction management.
  In this approach, selected TB-CSPN coordination mechanisms are mapped onto FPGA primitives, creating a hardware-native semantic coordination layer. Focus is not on acceleration, but on enforcing temporal synchronization, semantic gating, authorization constraints, and bounded coordination behavior directly in hardware. Semantic reasoning remains adaptive and software-driven, while embedded coordination semantics become deterministic.
tldr: Proposes a hardware-enforced semantic coordination architecture using FPGAs and TB-CSPN to achieve bounded latency, deterministic coordination, and enforceable safety guarantees for heterogeneous autonomous systems, without focusing on acceleration.
tldr_zh: 提出一种基于FPGA和TB-CSPN的硬件强制语义协调架构，以实现异构自主系统的有界延迟、确定性协调和可执行的安全保证，而不侧重于加速。

title: SimWorlds: A Multi-Agent System for Dynamic 3D Scene Creation
summary: LLM agents are increasingly used to translate natural language into 3D scenes in a procedural way, but existing systems focus on static output. Dynamic 4D scenes from text alone, in which liquids flow, particles emit, rigid bodies cascade, and articulated mechanisms move, remain largely unexplored despite their value as editable content and as physics-grounded training data for video generation and embodied AI. Two challenges set the dynamic case apart from static text-to-scene work: an agent must jointly coordinate spatial layout, multiple physics solvers, temporal sequencing, camera, and lighting in a single coherent scene, and verifying motion correctness from rendered video is fundamentally harder than judging a single image. We present SimWorlds: a multi-agent framework that produces dynamic, editable 4D scenes from text, with Blender-specific procedural knowledge, a planner-coder-reviewer workflow driving a fixed ordered sequence of construction stages, a layered scene protocol enforced by a deterministic verifier, and a runtime-state inspection tool suite that catches mechanism failures the rendered image cannot reveal.
