On R2R val-unseen, FSC-VLN improves SR/OSR/SPL over a StreamVLN-style baseline under two training-data regimes, with larger gains on long-horizon episodes; ablations further support the dual-query design (separating future and action queries).
summary_zh:
端到端视觉-语言导航（VLN）结合因果视觉-语言模型可直接将指令与自我中心观测映射至动作，但标准行为克隆仅监督下一个动作，并未明确训练策略状态以预测未来视觉结果。我们首先提出一个诊断性问题：若在训练和测试时将专家轨迹的未来图像作为特权输入提供给策略，该额外视觉证据是否有助于当前动作的选择？（在真实部署的测试阶段无法获取这些专家轨迹的未来图像，因此我们仅将该设定用作特权输入诊断。）答案是肯定的；这一合理性检验表明，未来观测能够提供丰富且可操作的线索。
随后我们提出一个可部署问题：在推理时无需访问未来图像的情况下，是否仍能通过仅将压缩的未来视觉隐变量作为训练监督来利用未来信息？我们提出基于未来状态条件的VLN方法（FSC-VLN），该方法新增一个未来查询令牌，并通过仅在训练阶段使用的目标分支（训练后移除）将其隐状态与前方Δ步的冻结视觉嵌入对齐。在R2R验证集未见环境下，FSC-VLN在两种训练数据模式下均比StreamVLN风格基线提升了SR/OSR/SPL指标，且在长轨迹任务中收益更大；消融实验进一步支持了双查询设计（分离未来查询与动作查询）。
tldr: This paper proposes Future-State-Conditioned VLN (FSC-VLN), a method that improves vision-language navigation by training a policy to align its hidden state with a future visual representation, without requiring future images at test time.
tldr_zh: 本文提出未来状态条件视觉语言导航（FSC-VLN），通过训练策略在隐状态中编码未来视觉表示来提升导航性能，且推理时不需未来图像。

title: SAGE: Subgoal-Conditioned Action Generation for Latent World Model Planning
summary: Latent world models have emerged as a powerful planning paradigm by learning action-conditioned predictive dynamics and using them as internal simulators to imagine and evaluate candidate action sequences. However, as the planning horizon grows, performance becomes increasingly constrained by proposal quality: a fixed candidate budget must search an exponentially larger action space, making it difficult to expose the world model to high-quality candidate futures for evaluation. In this paper, we introduce a prior-conditioned planner that replaces random proposal initialization with structured guidance. At each planning stage, a goal-conditioned generator predicts the next reachable latent subgoal for a specified duration, which is then used to condition the generation of candidate action sequences. To capture semantic information across temporal scales, we use subgoals of varying durations as priors, balancing fine-grained local control with higher-level long-horizon progress. Then the frozen world model evaluates and refines these subgoal-conditioned proposals before execution. Experiments on PushT and OGBench Cube show that coupling latent subgoal decomposition with prior-conditioned action generation substantially improves long-horizon planning while preserving strong short-horizon performance. To be specific, when the target offset is $150$, it raises PushT success from $12.7\%$ to $64.7\%$ and OGBench Cube success from $26.7\%$ to $67.3\%$.
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型通过学习基于动作的条件预测动力学，并将其作为内部模拟器来想象和评估候选动作序列，已成为一种强大的规划范式。然而，随着规划时间跨度的增长，性能越来越受到提案质量的制约：固定的候选预算需要在呈指数级增长的动作空间中进行搜索，这使得世界模型难以获得高质量的候选未来状态用于评估。本文提出了一种先验条件规划器，用结构化引导替代随机提案初始化。在每个规划阶段，一个目标条件生成器预测指定时间范围内下一个可达的潜在子目标，并以此为基础生成候选动作序列。为捕捉跨时间尺度的语义信息，我们采用不同时间跨度的子目标作为先验，从而在细粒度的局部控制与高层级的长远进程之间取得平衡。随后，冻结的世界模型在执行前对这些子目标条件提案进行评估与优化。在PushT和OGBench Cube上的实验表明，将潜在子目标分解与先验条件动作生成相结合，能显著提升长时域规划性能，同时保持优异的短时域表现。具体而言，当目标偏移量为150时，PushT任务的成功率从12.7%提升至64.7%，OGBench Cube任务的成功率从26.7%提升至67.3%。
tldr: This paper proposes a prior-conditioned planner that uses a goal-conditioned generator to produce latent subgoals, which then guide the generation of candidate action sequences for latent world model planning, significantly improving long-horizon control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种先验条件规划器，通过目标条件生成器产生潜在子目标，进而指导候选动作序列的生成，显著提升了潜在世界模型的长时域规划性能。

title: VGOcc: Learning Visual-Geometric Gaussians for Vision-Centric 3D Driving Occupancy Prediction
summary: Vision-only occupancy prediction requires recovering a semantic 3D occupancy field from calibrated surround-view images, where each view provides observations with ambiguous depth along camera rays. Existing methods have progressed from dense structured representations to sparse Gaussian primitives, improving the efficiency of 3D scene representation. However, Gaussian learning still relies primarily on image domain features, which provide limited explicit geometric information for volumetric reasoning. Our key observation is that effective Gaussian occupancy modeling requires not only sparse primitives, but also richer geometric and semantic learning cues. In this paper, we propose VGOcc, which learns visual and geometric cues from foundation models for Gaussian modeling. VGOcc incorporates these cues into primitive initialization and refinement, yielding a representation termed Visual-Geometric Gaussians tailored to semantic occupancy prediction. Specifically, we propose Visual-Geometric Gaussian Birth to form spatially balanced Gaussian centers from ray depth hypotheses, while visual semantic features initialize primitive attributes. Next, we design Pose-Aware Feature Learning to combine foundation tokens with camera embeddings and calibrated ray information. Features from neighboring views are then aggregated at projected 3D locations for each Gaussian refinement stage. Finally, Gaussian decoder refines birth Gaussians with pose-aware features and renders them into semantic occupancy. Experiments on nuScenes demonstrate that VGOcc achieves state-of-the-art performance in vision-only 3D occupancy prediction. Codes will be available at https://github.com/JHLin42in/VGOcc.
summary_zh: 纯视觉占据预测要求从标定的环视图像中恢复语义三维占据场，而每个视角沿相机射线提供的观测深度存在模糊性。现有方法已从稠密结构化表示发展为稀疏高斯基元，提升了三维场景表示的效率。然而，高斯学习仍主要依赖图像域特征，这类特征为体积推理提供的显式几何信息有限。我们的关键发现是：有效的高斯占据建模不仅需要稀疏基元，更需要更丰富的几何与语义学习线索。本文提出VGOcc方法，从基础模型中学习视觉与几何线索用于高斯建模。VGOcc将这些线索融入基元初始化和细化过程，形成专为语义占据预测设计的视觉-几何高斯表示。具体而言，我们提出视觉-几何高斯生成机制，基于射线深度假设构建空间平衡的高斯中心，同时利用视觉语义特征初始化基元属性。接着设计位姿感知特征学习模块，将基础模型令牌与相机嵌入及标定射线信息结合，并在每个高斯细化阶段的投影三维位置处聚合邻域视角特征。最后，高斯解码器利用位姿感知特征优化生成的高斯基元，并将其渲染为语义占据场。在nuScenes数据集上的实验表明，VGOcc在纯视觉三维占据预测中达到了最优性能。代码将开源至 https://github.com/JHLin42in/VGOcc。
tldr: VGOcc introduces Visual-Geometric Gaussians for vision-only 3D occupancy prediction in autonomous driving, leveraging foundation models to provide richer geometric and semantic cues for Gaussian-based scene representation and achieving state-of-the-art results on nuScenes.
tldr_zh: VGOcc 将视觉-几何高斯引入仅基于视觉的3D占据预测，利用基础模型提供更丰富的几何和语义线索进行高斯场景表示，在 nuScenes 上达到最先进性能。

title: Optimization of sim-to-real transfer in the humanoid robot NICO
summary: Robotic grasping requires accurate coordination between visual perception, object localization, inverse kinematics, and hand control. However, when movements planned in simulation are executed on a physical robot, the sim-to-real gap can cause small positioning errors that prevent successful grasping. In our previous work, we introduced a low-cost haptic calibration method that improved 2D reaching accuracy of the humanoid robot NICO. In this paper, we extend this approach from reaching to tabletop object grasping by adding YOLO-based object and hand detection, stereo vision-based localization using the robot's built-in low-resolution fisheye cameras, and task-specific corrections for grasp execution. Together, these components form a novel calibration-based grasping pipeline that does not require RGB-D cameras, motion capture, or external tracking systems. We also implemented a visual feedback model that aligns the robot hand with the detected object before grasping. Our results show that the fully nonlinear calibration model achieved the best performance inside the calibrated area, while the visual feedback model achieved the highest overall grasping success across the full tabletop workspace.
summary_zh: 机器人抓取需要视觉感知、目标定位、逆运动学与手部控制之间的精确协调。然而，当在仿真中规划的运动被部署至实体机器人执行时，仿真与现实的差异会导致细微定位误差，从而阻碍成功抓取。在先前工作中，我们提出了一种低成本触觉标定方法，有效提升了仿人机器人NICO的二维到达精度。本文将该方法从到达任务扩展至桌面物体抓取，具体改进包括：引入基于YOLO的物体与手部检测、利用机器人内置低分辨率鱼眼摄像头实现立体视觉定位，以及针对抓取执行的任务特定校正。这些模块共同构成了一套新型的基于标定的抓取流程，该流程无需RGB-D摄像头、动作捕捉系统或外部追踪装置。我们还实现了一种视觉反馈模型，使机器人在抓取前将手部与检测到的物体对齐。结果表明，全非线性标定模型在标定区域内性能最优，而视觉反馈模型在整个桌面工作空间中实现了最高的总体抓取成功率。
tldr: This paper extends a haptic calibration method from reaching to tabletop grasping on the NICO humanoid robot, using YOLO-based detection and stereo vision to reduce sim-to-real errors without external tracking.
tldr_zh: 本文将对NICO人形机器人上的触觉校准方法从伸展动作扩展到桌面抓取，利用YOLO检测和立体视觉减少仿真到现实的误差，且无需外部追踪系统。

title: Towards Torque-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Quadruped Locomotion
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for legged robots is advancing locomotion, demonstrating its ability to adapt to new and challenging terrain. Traditionally, these RL locomotion frameworks are position-based, making the policy less adaptable to terrain types and requiring state estimation techniques in the observation space, i.e., linear velocity. Moreover, these RL frameworks often use small, lightweight quadrupeds that are limited in their viability for high-complexity tasks due to hardware constraints. This work explores an RL torque control framework for heavyweight high-torque quadrupeds. The RL framework in this paper can traverse rough terrain and effectively track a desired linear velocity without requiring knowledge of the agent's current velocity. Using Nvidia's Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab, simulation results of the RL torque control policy are shown on the Unitree B1 quadruped, achieving speeds of 3.5 m/s and 1.5 rad/s. In addition, the quadruped can walk up and down stairs without the aid of an exteroceptive sensor.
summary_zh: 基于强化学习的足式机器人运动控制技术正在不断进步，展现出适应复杂新地形的能力。传统强化学习运动框架多采用基于位置的控制模式，导致策略对不同地形类型的适应能力较弱，且需要在观测空间中引入状态估计技术（如线速度估计）。此外，现有框架通常使用轻量级小型四足机器人，由于硬件限制难以胜任高复杂度任务。本文探索了一种适用于重型高扭矩四足机器人的强化学习力矩控制框架。该框架无需获取智能体当前速度信息，即可穿越崎岖地形并有效跟踪期望线速度。通过英伟达Isaac Sim与Isaac Lab仿真平台，验证了该强化学习力矩控制策略在宇树B1四足机器人上的性能，可实现3.5米/秒的线速度和1.5弧度/秒的角速度。更值得关注的是，该四足机器人无需借助外部传感器即可自主上下楼梯。
tldr: This paper presents a torque-driven reinforcement learning framework for heavyweight quadrupeds, enabling traversal of rough terrain and velocity tracking without velocity state estimation or exteroceptive sensors, demonstrated in simulation on the Unitree B1 robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向重型四足机器人的扭矩驱动强化学习框架，无需速度状态估计或外部传感器即可实现崎岖地形穿越和速度跟踪，并在Unitree B1机器人的仿真中进行了验证。

title: Isaac Sim-to-Real: Reinforcement Learning based Locomotion for Quadrupeds
summary: Learning-based approaches to locomotion have risen in popularity in recent years, showing the capability for complex legged locomotion and whole-body control. Reinforcement learning (RL), the primary learning-based approach for locomotion, often utilizes a high-performance simulation tool, providing a controlled and efficient training and development environment. However, policies that perform well in simulation frequently encounter unexpected challenges when deployed on a physical system, known as the sim-to-real gap. This work presents a robust RL locomotion framework capable of whole-body control. The proposed RL framework utilizes Nvidia's new set of simulation tools, Isaac Sim, and its companion RL framework, Isaac Lab, for training, achieving a zero-shot sim-to-real policy. The performance of our policy is validated on physical hardware using the Unitree Go1, with experimental results showing similar velocity tracking performance to the quadruped's integrated controller, with a greater ability to recover from large disturbances, and achieve linear velocities of 2.0 m/s and angular velocities of 1.8 rad/s.
summary_zh: 基于学习的运动控制在近年来日益普及，展现出在复杂腿式运动与全身控制方面的能力。作为运动控制领域主要的基于学习方法，强化学习常利用高性能仿真工具，提供受控且高效的训练与开发环境。然而，在仿真中表现良好的策略部署到物理系统时，常会遇到意料之外的挑战，即"仿真到现实"的差距。本项工作提出了一种能够实现全身控制的鲁棒强化学习运动框架。该框架利用英伟达新一代仿真工具Isaac Sim及其配套强化学习框架Isaac Lab进行训练，实现了零样本的仿真到现实策略迁移。我们采用Unitree Go1四足机器人对策略性能进行了物理硬件验证，实验结果显示：该策略的速度跟踪性能与四足机器人集成控制器相当，但具备更强的抵抗大扰动恢复能力，可实现2.0米/秒的线速度和1.8弧度/秒的角速度。
tldr: This paper presents a reinforcement learning framework using Nvidia's Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab to train a quadruped locomotion policy that achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on the Unitree Go1, demonstrating robust whole-body control and recovery from disturbances.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用Nvidia Isaac Sim和Isaac Lab的强化学习框架，训练四足机器人运动策略，实现在Unitree Go1上的零样本仿真到现实迁移，展示了鲁棒的全向控制与扰动恢复能力。

title: Importance Sampling and PCA for Finding Failures in Commercial Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Methods for discovering rare failures in autonomous systems have so far been demonstrated almost exclusively in simulations with simple, academic driving stacks, leaving open whether they generalize to the more robust planners used in commercial systems. We address this gap by applying two rare-event discovery algorithms to a commercial autonomous trucking stack. Adaptive stress testing (AST) uses reinforcement learning to search for the most likely noise trajectories leading to a simulated collision, while diffusion-based failure sampling (DiFS) trains a denoising diffusion model to sample a diverse set of failures. We show that both algorithms find simulated collisions during merge and cut-in maneuvers where traditional Monte Carlo simulation does not. To make these failures actionable, we introduce a statistical analysis based on principal component analysis (PCA) that classifies failures into common modes and identifies the timesteps that most influence the outcome. We cluster the principal components and invert the PCA transform to recover generalized noise trajectories, and show that these trajectories reproduce failures in identical and similar scenarios. This provides a path from failure discovery to systematic diagnosis of perception-level flaws.
summary_zh: 目前在自主系统中发现罕见故障的方法，几乎全部仅通过使用简单的学术驾驶堆栈进行仿真验证，尚未验证这些方法是否能泛化至商业系统中更加鲁棒的规划器。为填补这一空白，我们将两种罕见事件发现算法应用于商用自动驾驶卡车堆栈。自适应压力测试（AST）利用强化学习搜索最有可能导致模拟碰撞的噪声轨迹，而基于扩散的故障采样（DiFS）则训练去噪扩散模型以采样多样化的故障集合。我们证明，在传统蒙特卡洛模拟无法发现的并道与切入操作中，这两种算法均能发现模拟碰撞。为使这些故障具备可操作性，我们引入基于主成分分析（PCA）的统计方法，将故障分类为常见模式，并识别对结果影响最大的时间步。我们对主成分进行聚类，并通过逆PCA变换恢复泛化的噪声轨迹，进而证明这些轨迹能够在相同及相似场景中复现故障。这为从故障发现到感知层面缺陷的系统性诊断提供了可行路径。
tldr: Applies AST and DiFS to a commercial autonomous trucking stack to discover rare collisions, and introduces PCA-based analysis to classify failure modes and recover generalized noise trajectories.
tldr_zh: 将AST和DiFS应用于商业自动驾驶卡车系统以发现罕见碰撞，并引入基于PCA的分析来分类故障模式并恢复通用噪声轨迹。

title: Distilling Global Traversability Priors for Image-based Affordance Prediction in Off-road Environments
summary: Standard methods for autonomous navigation in unstructured terrain are prone to myopic behaviors in long-horizon scenarios. The use of metric maps built from LiDAR or cameras provides necessary local geometry and semantic information but is strictly limited by depth sensing range. By discarding data beyond the mapping horizon robots suffer from suboptimal, short-sighted decisions. To recover this lost information, we focus on extracting long-range traversability-aware frontiers directly from first-person-view (FPV) images. By leveraging satellite imagery, we compute the set of feasible navigation paths for a dataset of image/pose pairs and use them to supervise our network, reducing the need for extensive human demonstration data. We demonstrate that this approach improves performance in long-range off-road navigation over existing methods by more than 10% in various offline benchmarks and reduces the number of human interventions incurred in a set of real-world experiments. More details can be found at https://theairlab.org/ss_frontiers_iros .
summary_zh: 在非结构化地形中进行自主导航的标准方法在长距离场景中容易产生短视行为。利用激光雷达或相机建立的度量地图虽能提供必要的局部几何与语义信息，但严格受限于深度感知范围。因丢弃超出建图范围的数据，机器人会做出次优的短视决策。为恢复这部分丢失的信息，我们聚焦于直接从第一人称视角（FPV）图像中提取具有远距离可通行性感知的前沿区域。通过利用卫星图像，我们为一组图像/位姿对计算出可行的导航路径集合，并以此监督网络训练，从而减少对大量人工演示数据的需求。实验证明，该方法在多种离线基准测试中，相较于现有方法将远程越野导航性能提升了超过10%，并在实际场景实验中减少了人工干预次数。更多详情请访问 https://theairlab.org/ss_frontiers_iros。
tldr: This paper introduces a method to distill global traversability priors from satellite imagery into a network that predicts long-range affordance from first-person-view images, improving long-horizon off-road navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种方法，从卫星图像中提取全局可通行先验，并将其蒸馏到网络中，用于从第一人称视角图像预测远距离的可通行属性，从而提升越野导航的长期规划能力。

title: Manifold-Guided Motion Planning for Tight Assemblies
summary: Motion planning for rigid-body assembly poses a fundamental challenge in robotics due to tight geometric constraints. In such scenarios, feasible motions often require passing through (near-)zero clearance configurations in which the parts are tightly constrained by contact. In this work, we introduce Critical-Manifold Guided RRT (CMG-RRT), a sampling-based planner designed specifically for tight assembly problems. Our key observation is that in tight assemblies, valid solution paths lie on or near a critical manifold: the subset of configuration space consisting of poses with at least one contact point between parts. CMG-RRT guides exploration by adaptively biasing sampling toward neighborhoods of the critical manifold using a hierarchical subdivision of the configuration space. We prove that CMG-RRT is probabilistically complete under standard clearance assumptions. Empirical evaluation on challenging rotational assembly benchmarks demonstrates a 100% success rate across all tested instances, including, to the best of our knowledge, the first fully automatic solution of the Elk disentanglement puzzle. Our open source software is available through our project page: https://www.cgl.cs.tau.ac.il/projects/tight-assembly-planning.
summary_zh: 刚体装配的运动规划由于存在严格的几何约束，对机器人技术构成了根本性挑战。在此类场景中，可行运动通常需要穿过（接近）零间隙的构型，即零件因接触而受到紧密约束。本文提出临界流形引导的RRT（CMG-RRT），这是一种专门针对紧密装配问题设计的基于采样的规划器。我们的关键发现是：在紧密装配中，有效解路径位于或靠近临界流形——即由零件间存在至少一个接触点的构型组成的构型空间子集。CMG-RRT通过利用构型空间的层次化细分，自适应地将采样偏向于临界流形邻域，从而引导探索过程。我们证明了在标准间隙假设下CMG-RRT具有概率完备性。在具有挑战性的旋转装配基准测试上的实证评估表明，所有测试实例均实现了100%的成功率，其中包括（据我们所知）首次全自动求解的麋鹿解谜难题。我们开源软件的获取方式见项目页面：https://www.cgl.cs.tau.ac.il/projects/tight-assembly-planning。
tldr: This paper introduces CMG-RRT, a sampling-based motion planner that biases exploration toward the critical manifold of contact configurations, achieving 100% success on challenging tight assembly benchmarks including the first fully automatic solution of the Elk disentanglement puzzle.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 CMG-RRT，一种基于采样的运动规划器，通过自适应地将采样偏向接触配置的临界流形，在紧装配基准测试中实现了 100% 的成功率，包括首次完全自动解决 Elk 解谜难题。

title: Receiver-Centered Robot-to-Human Handover with Grasp-Aware Object Orientation
summary: Collaborative robots are increasingly sharing workspaces with human operators, making tool handover a frequent and safety-critical micro-interaction. However, traditional static handovers often lead to awkward grasps when handling asymmetric industrial tools. This paper presents a receiver-centered voice-driven adaptive handover system for mechanical tools, built on a Franka cobot. Using an LLM for intention recognition and MediaPipe for real-time 3D hand tracking, the framework dynamically adjusts the end-effector's orientation to present tools in an ergonomically optimal, handle-first pose. A within-subjects study compared this adaptive approach with an object-agnostic static baseline. The results demonstrate that the adaptive system reduces the grasp delay for asymmetric tools, improving the fluency of the interaction. Furthermore, the adaptive strategy improved specific trust-related perceptions, particularly motion predictability and perceived task simplicity.
summary_zh: 协作机器人越来越多地与人类操作员共享工作空间，这使得工具交接成为一种频繁且关乎安全的关键微交互过程。然而，在处理非对称工业工具时，传统的静态交接方式往往会导致笨拙的抓取动作。本文提出了一种基于接收者中心、由语音驱动的机械工具自适应交接系统，该系统以Franka协作机器人为平台。该框架利用大语言模型进行意图识别，并借助MediaPipe实现实时三维手部追踪，能够动态调整末端执行器的姿态，以符合人体工学的优化方式将工具以手柄朝前的姿势呈现。一项被试内研究将这种自适应方法与忽略物体特征的静态基线方法进行了对比。结果表明，自适应系统减少了非对称工具的抓取延迟，提升了交互的流畅性。此外，自适应策略还改善了用户对特定信任维度的感知，尤其是运动可预测性和感知任务简易性。
tldr: This paper presents a receiver-centered, voice-driven adaptive handover system for human-robot tool handover, using an LLM for intention recognition and real-time hand tracking to dynamically adjust tool orientation, and shows improved grasp delay and trust perceptions compared to a static baseline.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种以接收者为中心的、由语音驱动的自适应人机工具交接系统，利用LLM进行意图识别和实时手部跟踪来动态调整工具朝向，实验表明相比静态基线，该方法改善了抓取延迟并提升了信任感知。

title: A2RL V\textsubscript{max}: The A2RL autonomous racing dataset for long-range, high-speed perception and multi-vehicle interaction
summary: In autonomous driving development, a perception dataset is crucial, as it provides fundamental data for training, testing, and validating algorithms for an autonomous vehicle's multimodal perception systems. So far, most research has concentrated on providing datasets for well-structured urban environments. This work introduces the A2RL V\textsubscript{max} open-source dataset, specifically designed for perception tasks in high-speed autonomous driving and multi-vehicle interaction. The dataset was captured during the 2024 Abu Dhabi Autonomous Racing League (A2RL), held at the Yas Marina F1 Circuit, with participation from all competing teams. It contains diverse scenarios, including single-vehicle data at varying speeds, multi-vehicle sessions, and the full final four-vehicle race. The dataset contains almost 30,000 professionally annotated LiDAR point clouds, along with RADAR point clouds. In particular, it is the first large-scale dataset in autonomous racing to feature professionally annotated LiDAR point clouds, enabling deep learning-based perception research. The data is provided in a developer-friendly format, enabling easy implementation and evaluation in future research. We provide implementation and evaluation for off-the-shelf 3D detection and tracking methods. Although baseline methods show promising results for both 3D detection and tracking, specialized methods are required to address the unique challenges of high-speed autonomous driving. For a detailed description of the dataset, please visit the \href{https://tum-avs.github.io/A2RL_Dataset_website/}{A2RL V\textsubscript{max} Dataset Website}
summary_zh: 在自动驾驶技术研发中，感知数据集至关重要，它为自动驾驶车辆多模态感知系统的训练、测试与算法验证提供基础数据。迄今为止，多数研究集中于结构化城市环境的数据集构建。本研究推出A2RL V\textsubscript{max}开源数据集，专门针对高速自动驾驶与多车交互场景中的感知任务设计。该数据集于2024年阿布扎比自动驾驶赛车联赛（A2RL）期间采集，比赛在亚斯码头F1赛道举行，所有参赛车队均参与数据采集。数据集包含丰富场景，涵盖不同速度下的单车数据、多车行驶阶段，以及完整的四车决赛过程。该数据集包含近30,000个经专业标注的激光雷达点云及雷达点云数据。特别值得关注的是，这是自动驾驶赛车领域首个大规模专业标注激光雷达点云数据集，为基于深度学习的感知研究提供了可能。数据以开发者友好格式提供，便于在后续研究中直接部署与评估。我们针对现有3D检测与追踪方法给出了实现方案与性能评估。尽管基线方法在3D检测与追踪方面展现出良好潜力，但应对高速自动驾驶特有挑战仍需专门化方法。关于数据集的详细描述，请访问\href{https://tum-avs.github.io/A2RL_Dataset_website/}{A2RL V\textsubscript{max}数据集官网}。
tldr: This paper introduces A2RL Vmax, a large-scale dataset for high-speed autonomous racing perception, featuring professionally annotated LiDAR and RADAR point clouds from the 2024 Abu Dhabi Autonomous Racing League.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 A2RL Vmax，一个专为高速自动驾驶赛车感知设计的大规模数据集，包含来自2024年阿布扎比自动驾驶赛车联赛的专业标注激光雷达和雷达点云。

title: From Sign Language Generation to Humanoid Execution: Vision-Language Guided Retargeting with Collision Mitigation
summary: Recent sign language generation (SLG) systems increasingly output dense 3D body representations, which better preserve full-body kinematics and geometry for downstream embodiment on humanoid robots. However, these generated motions frequently exhibit self-intersections such as hand-hand and hand-torso penetration. While such artifacts may be tolerated in offline rendering, they become critical in humanoid execution as they lead to infeasible inverse-kinematics (IK) solutions, collisions, and unstable retargeted trajectories. We present a system-level framework that bridges SLG outputs to humanoid joint-space execution via two components. First, we introduce a volumetric SMPL-X collision-mitigation module that projects generated signing motions toward physically plausible configurations while minimally deviating from the original trajectory. Second, we propose a vision-language-guided retargeting algorithm built on an IK backbone: a VLM serves as a visual critic over rendered humanoid motion, identifies embodiment-specific failure modes, and triggers targeted task-space corrections. Our results highlight collision handling and perception-guided refinement as key missing components for reliable humanoid signing.
summary_zh: 近期的手语生成系统逐渐倾向于输出密集的三维人体表征，从而更完整地保留全身运动学与几何信息，以支持下游仿人机器人的具身化实现。然而，这些生成动作常出现自身碰撞问题，例如手与手、手与躯干的交叉渗透。此类伪影在离线渲染中或许尚可容忍，但在仿人机器人执行过程中会引发关键性问题，导致逆运动学求解不可行、碰撞发生以及重定位轨迹失稳。我们提出一种系统级框架，通过两个核心组件将手语生成输出与仿人机器人的关节空间执行相衔接。首先，我们引入基于体素的SMPL-X碰撞缓解模块，该模块在最小程度偏离原始轨迹的前提下，将生成的手语动作投影至物理合理的构型。其次，我们提出基于逆运动学框架的视觉-语言引导重定位算法：视觉语言模型作为渲染后仿人机器人运动的视觉评判器，识别具身化特有的失效模式，并触发针对性的任务空间修正。实验结果表明，碰撞处理与感知引导优化是实现可靠仿人机器人手语的关键缺失环节。
tldr: A system framework that connects sign language generation to humanoid robot execution using volumetric collision mitigation and vision-language-guided retargeting.
tldr_zh: 一个将手语生成连接到人形机器人执行的系统框架，采用体积碰撞缓解和视觉语言引导的重定向。

title: Seg2Grasp: A Robust Modular Suction Grasping in Bin Picking
summary: Current bin picking methods that rely heavily on end-to-end learning often falter when confronted with unfamiliar or complex objects in unstructured environments. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Seg2Grasp, a modular pipeline designed for robust suction grasping in dynamic and cluttered bin scenarios. Seg2Grasp is built on a three-step process: Segmentation, Grasping, and Classification. The Segmentation module employs a Transformer-based model to generate class-agnostic object masks from RGB-D images, ensuring accurate detection across various conditions. The Grasping module uses surface normals and mask proposals to determine the optimal suction points, enhancing grasp success. Finally, the Classification module leverages fine-tuned open-vocabulary Mask-CLIP for precise object identification, enabling versatile handling of diverse objects. Real-world robotic experiments demonstrate that Seg2Grasp outperforms existing methods in success rates and adaptability, establishing it as a powerful tool for automated bin picking in industrial settings.
summary_zh: 摘要：当前严重依赖端到端学习的料箱抓取方法，在非结构化环境中面对陌生或复杂物体时经常失效。为克服这些局限性，我们提出Seg2Grasp——一种专为动态杂乱料箱场景中稳健吸盘抓取设计的模块化流程。Seg2Grasp基于三步流程构建：分割、抓取与分类。分割模块采用基于Transformer的模型，从RGB-D图像生成与类别无关的物体掩码，确保在各种条件下实现精准检测。抓取模块利用表面法线与掩码提议确定最优吸盘点，提升抓取成功率。最后，分类模块借助微调后的开放词汇Mask-CLIP实现精确物体识别，从而灵活处理多样物体。真实机器人实验表明，Seg2Grasp在成功率和适应性方面均优于现有方法，成为工业场景中自动化料箱抓取的强大工具。
tldr: Seg2Grasp proposes a modular suction grasping pipeline for bin picking, combining Transformer-based segmentation, surface-normal grasp selection, and open-vocabulary classification with Mask-CLIP.
tldr_zh: Seg2Grasp 提出了一种模块化的吸盘抓取流水线，结合基于Transformer的分割、表面法向量抓取点选择和基于Mask-CLIP的开放词汇分类。

title: Predicting Grasping Compliance in Robotic Hands through Analytical-Model-Informed Neural Networks
summary: In robotic manipulation studies, grasping is often treated as a binary success or failure problem, usually defined by whether the object simply stays in the hand. For forceful tool use, however, this view is insufficient because grasp compliance becomes a critical factor governing how the hand and tool behave under load. Compliance arises from coupled kinematics, grasp configuration, passive mechanics, and contact conditions, producing nonlinear behavior in which deformation and interaction forces influence each other. Understanding this relationship is essential for predictive models of how a grasped tool and a compliant hand jointly respond to external loading. In underactuated hands, these effects are amplified: such designs offer low cost and adaptive grasping, but make compliance behavior more difficult to model and predict. Our goal is therefore to develop a predictive model for grasped tool behavior during forceful interactions. To address this challenge, we introduce an analytical model informed neural network (AMINN), a hybrid predictive model that combines an analytical mechanics layer with data driven learning to estimate grasp stability and in hand tool displacement under external loading. The model is evaluated on a three finger underactuated robotic hand and shows strong predictive capability with mechanically meaningful outputs across diverse loading conditions. Compared with a black box multilayer perceptron baseline, AMINN also achieves better energy based physical consistency. Beyond prediction accuracy alone, this framework advances physically interpretable learning for robotic manipulation and supports more reliable, safer, and more trustworthy autonomous tool use in safety critical settings during forceful interaction.
summary_zh: 在机器人操作研究中，抓取通常被视为一个二元成功或失败问题，其判定标准往往是物体是否简单地保持在手中。然而，对于需要施加力的工具使用场景，这种观点并不充分，因为抓取柔顺性成为控制手部与工具在负载下行为的关键因素。柔顺性源于耦合运动学、抓取构型、被动力学及接触条件，会产生非线性行为——变形与接触力相互影响。理解这一关系对于建立预测模型至关重要，该模型需描述被夹持工具与柔顺手部如何共同响应外部载荷。在欠驱动手中，这些效应被放大：此类设计虽成本低且能自适应抓取，却使柔顺行为的建模与预测更为困难。因此，我们的目标是开发一种在强力交互过程中预测被夹持工具行为的模型。为应对这一挑战，我们提出分析模型引导的神经网络（AMINN），这是一种融合分析力学层与数据驱动学习的混合预测模型，可评估外部载荷下的抓取稳定性及工具在手内的位移。该模型在三指欠驱动机械手上进行了评估，展现出强大的预测能力，能在多种载荷条件下输出具有力学意义的预测结果。与黑箱多层感知机基线模型相比，AMINN在基于能量的物理一致性方面表现更优。除预测精度外，该框架还推动了机器人操作中物理可解释学习的发展，支持在安全关键场景中实现更可靠、更安全且更值得信赖的自主工具使用。
tldr: Proposes an analytical-model-informed neural network (AMINN) that combines mechanics with data-driven learning to predict grasp compliance and in-hand tool displacement for underactuated robotic hands under external loading.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种分析模型指导的神经网络（AMINN），结合力学与数据驱动学习，预测欠驱动机械手在外力加载下的抓取顺应性和工具位移。

title: Reinforcement Learning: From Algorithms To Foundation Models
summary:
Reinforcement learning (RL) provides a framework for sequential decision making under explicit objectives. In its classical form, RL studies how an agent should act to maximise long-term reward in a dynamic environment. In richer settings, the problem extends beyond a single agent and fixed environment: intelligent behavior may require strategic interaction, adaptation to uncertainty, and reasoning over high-dimensional worlds. This thesis studies RL from two perspectives: algorithms in games and RL in the era of foundation models.
  The first part focuses on multi-agent RL in games. It examines how incentives, policies, and equilibrium concepts interact in competitive and general-sum environments, spanning two-player zero-sum games, large-scale video games, and multi-player settings with general structure. These works investigate learning in multi-agent systems and the behavior of RL methods in interactive environments. The second part studies RL with generative and foundation models, motivated by the idea that prior knowledge can enrich sequential decision making. Pretrained generative models and learned world models serve as representation tools and structured priors for planning, control, and policy optimization. The thesis develops diffusion-based world models, investigates RL for efficient video generation, explores generative models as policy classes, and studies interactive video world models in which actions shape future observations. It also addresses long-horizon modeling through architectures with memory. Together, these contributions present a unified view of RL as objective-driven adaptation in complex sequential domains. From strategic games to generative world models, the thesis highlights how RL connects decision making, environment modeling, and emerging foundation-model capabilities, offering a broader perspective on the principles underlying intelligent behavior.
summary_zh:
强化学习（RL）为在明确目标下进行序列决策提供了框架。其经典形式研究智能体如何在动态环境中采取行动以最大化长期回报。在更复杂的设定中，问题超越了单一智能体和固定环境：智能行为可能需要策略互动、对不确定性的适应以及在高维世界中的推理。本论文从两个角度研究强化学习：博弈中的算法与基础模型时代的强化学习。

第一部分关注博弈中的多智能体强化学习。它探讨了在竞争与一般和环境中，激励、策略与均衡概念如何相互作用，涵盖两人零和博弈、大规模视频游戏以及具有一般结构的多玩家设定。这些研究考察了多智能体系统中的学习过程以及强化学习方法在交互环境中的行为。第二部分研究基于生成模型与基础模型的强化学习，其动机在于先验知识能够丰富序列决策。预训练生成模型与学习到的世界模型被用作表征工具及用于规划、控制与策略优化的结构化先验。本论文开发了基于扩散的世界模型，研究了用于高效视频生成的强化学习，探索了作为策略类别的生成模型，并研究了动作塑造未来观测的交互式视频世界模型。它还通过具有记忆的架构解决了长时域建模问题。这些贡献共同呈现了强化学习作为复杂序列领域中目标驱动适应的统一视角。从策略博弈到生成世界模型，本论文凸显了强化学习如何将决策制定、环境建模与新兴基础模型能力相连接，为理解智能行为背后的原理提供了更广阔的视角。
tldr: This thesis studies reinforcement learning from two perspectives: multi-agent RL in games and RL with generative/foundation models for decision making, including diffusion-based world models and video world models for control.
tldr_zh: 本论文从两个角度研究强化学习：博弈中的多智能体RL，以及基于生成模型/基础模型的RL用于决策，包括基于扩散的世界模型和用于控制的可交互视频世界模型。

title: Thinking in Video: Can Video Generators Really Reason About the Real World?
summary: Recent advances in world models and video generation have given rise to an emerging reasoning paradigm that leverages video generative models to simulate, predict, and reason about real-world dynamics. We redefine this paradigm as Thinking in Video, where video is not merely an output artifact but a medium for constructing, extending, and verifying causal thought. However, this promise remains unverified: convincing rollouts may reflect memorized appearances rather than causal understanding, while existing metrics separate perceptual fidelity from semantic logic. To evaluate whether video generators support such reasoning, we introduce the Causal-Generative Dual-Judge (CGDJ), auditing World Model Consistency from two perspectives. Explicit Causal Perception tests whether a generator reads a video scenario as a reasoning problem through spatio-temporal flattened visual question answering, while Implicit Generative Perception-Prediction Gap evaluates whether it renders the causal consequence as a consistent future video. Applying CGDJ to representative open- and closed-source generators reveals a clear Perception-Prediction Gap: open-source models produce plausible dynamics despite near-zero explicit causal perception, whereas advanced closed-source systems show stronger but still limited alignment between reasoning and generation. Further analysis exposes audio-visual misalignment, where models verbalize correct causal logic more reliably than they render it, challenging the "world simulator" narrative.
summary_zh: 世界模型与视频生成的最新进展催生了一种新兴的推理范式，该范式利用视频生成模型来模拟、预测和推理现实世界的动态变化。我们将这一范式重新定义为"视频思维"——视频不再仅仅是输出的产物，而是构建、延展和验证因果思维的媒介。然而，这一愿景尚未得到验证：看似合理的推演结果可能反映的是记忆中的表象而非因果理解，而现有评估指标则将感知逼真度与语义逻辑相分离。为评估视频生成器是否真正支持此类推理，我们提出了"因果-生成双裁判"（CGDJ）方法，从两个维度审计世界模型的一致性。显式因果感知测试通过时空展开的视觉问答，检验生成器是否将视频场景解读为推理问题；隐式生成感知-预测差距则评估生成器是否将因果后果呈现为连贯的未来视频。将CGDJ应用于代表性开源与闭源生成器后，我们发现了一个显著的"感知-预测差距"：开源模型虽能生成看似合理的动态变化，但其显式因果感知能力近乎为零；而先进的闭源系统虽展现出更强的因果推理与生成一致性，但仍存在明显局限。进一步分析揭示了视听错位现象——模型在语言化正确因果逻辑时的可靠性高于视觉呈现，这挑战了"世界模拟器"的叙事框架。
tldr: This paper introduces the Causal-Generative Dual-Judge (CGDJ) audit to evaluate whether video generative models can genuinely reason about real-world dynamics, revealing a gap between plausible video generation and explicit causal understanding.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了因果-生成双重裁判（CGDJ）审计，用于评估视频生成模型是否能真正推理现实世界的动态，揭示了看似合理的视频生成与明确因果理解之间的差距。

title: Generalize and Guide: Decomposing Rewards for Few-Shot Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) provides a powerful framework for learning from demonstrations. However, real-world tasks often exhibit substantial natural variations (e.g., picking up mugs with varying shapes), making it impractical to collect demonstrations that fully specify a new task under every possible scenario. In practice, while demonstrations for the target task are limited, it is often easier to obtain datasets of heterogeneous but related behaviors. This motivates the problem of few-shot IRL with multi-task demonstrations (FM-IRL), where an agent must learn a new task with substantial variations from only a limited number of target-task demonstrations, together with sufficient demonstrations of related tasks and online agent experience. To do so, we must both recover the expert distribution of the new task and provide guidance when the agent deviates from it. We introduce Multitask discriminator Proximity-Guided IRL (MPG), which learns two complementary reward components: (1) a generalizable discriminator that transfers shared structure across related tasks to identify expert behavior in a new task, and (2) a proximity function that measures how far a state deviates from expert behavior and provides corrective guidance during exploration. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on multiple challenging navigation and manipulation tasks under significant variations (e.g., object configurations, table layouts, and initial robot poses), achieving an average success rate of 81.2%, outperforming the strongest per-task baseline by an average of 24.7 percentage points.
summary_zh: 逆强化学习（IRL）为从示范中学习提供了强大的框架。然而，现实任务往往表现出显著的自然变化（例如，抓取形状各异的杯子），这使得在每种可能场景下收集用于完全指定新任务的示范变得不切实际。实践中，虽然目标任务的示范有限，但通常更容易获得异构但相关行为的数据集。这催生了基于多任务示范的少样本逆强化学习（FM-IRL）问题：智能体必须仅依靠有限的目标任务示范，结合充足的相关任务示范和在线智能体经验，来学习具有显著变化的新任务。为此，我们既要恢复新任务的专家分布，又要在智能体偏离该分布时提供引导。我们提出了多任务鉴别器邻近引导逆强化学习（MPG），该方法学习两个互补的奖励组成部分：（1）可泛化的鉴别器，它能够跨相关任务传递共享结构，以识别新任务中的专家行为；（2）邻近函数，用于衡量状态偏离专家行为的程度，并在探索过程中提供修正性引导。我们在多个具有显著变化（如物体配置、桌面布局和机器人初始姿态）的高难度导航与操作任务上验证了该方法的有效性，平均成功率达到81.2%，比最优的逐任务基线平均高出24.7个百分点。
tldr: This paper proposes MPG, a few-shot inverse reinforcement learning method that decomposes rewards into a generalizable discriminator and a proximity function to learn new tasks from limited demonstrations, achieving strong results on navigation and manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出MPG，一种将奖励分解为可泛化判别器和邻近函数的少样本逆强化学习方法，能从少量演示中学习新任务，在导航和操作任务上取得了优异结果。

title: SLAM in Low-Light Environments: Project Report
summary: Simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) is one of the fundamental problems in robotics, as it enables autonomous operations in real-world scenarios. Under low illumination, reduced contrast, sensor noise, and motion blur degrade both feature extraction and feature matching, while compensating with LiDAR, depth, or thermal sensors raises cost, power draw, and integration complexity. Existing benchmarks remain dominated by well-lit indoor or daylight sequences, leaving open how far SLAM with standard RGB cameras can be pushed in the dark. We benchmark six systems spanning the feature-based, direct, filter-based, and learning-based paradigms - ORB-SLAM3, DSO, Kimera-VIO, OpenVINS, DPVO, and DPV-SLAM - on five LaMARia sequences of varying difficulty and illumination, reporting absolute and relative pose error alongside control-point recall. Kimera-VIO is the only system to track all five sequences to completion, combining the lowest relative pose error with steadily growing absolute error due to the absence of loop closure; DPVO and DPV-SLAM never lose tracking but incur absolute errors of roughly 100 m under low light; and the classical monocular pipelines (ORB-SLAM3, DSO) together with the filter-based OpenVINS fail outright or diverge on most of the harder and low-light sequences. The results suggest that RGB-only SLAM maintains stable low-light tracking only when both inertial fusion and global optimization are present. Closing the remaining gap will likely require low-light-specific learned front-ends or a return to complementary sensing.
summary_zh: 同时定位与地图构建（SLAM）是机器人学的基本问题之一，它使自主系统能够在真实场景中运行。在低光照条件下，对比度降低、传感器噪声和运动模糊会同时削弱特征提取与特征匹配的效果，而采用激光雷达、深度传感器或热成像仪进行补偿则会增加成本、功耗及系统集成复杂度。现有基准测试仍以光照充足的室内或白天场景为主，尚未明确标准RGB相机在黑暗中能将SLAM推进到何种程度。我们基于五种难度与光照条件各异的LaMARia序列，对涵盖基于特征、直接法、滤波法与学习范式的六种SLAM系统——ORB-SLAM3、DSO、Kimera-VIO、OpenVINS、DPVO和DPV-SLAM——进行了基准测试，报告了绝对位姿误差、相对位姿误差以及控制点召回率。在所有系统中，仅Kimera-VIO成功完成了全部五个序列的追踪，其相对位姿误差最低，但因缺乏闭环检测导致绝对误差持续增长；DPVO与DPV-SLAM从未丢失追踪，但在低光照下绝对误差约达100米；而经典单目管线（ORB-SLAM3、DSO）及基于滤波法的OpenVINS在大部分困难与低光序列中完全失效或发散。结果表明，仅依赖RGB的SLAM只有在惯性融合与全局优化同时存在时，才能维持稳定的低光追踪。要弥合现有差距，可能需要开发针对低光环境的学习型前端，或回归互补感知方案。
tldr: This report benchmarks RGB-only SLAM systems on low-light sequences, finding that only Kimera-VIO (with IMU fusion and global optimization) tracks all sequences, while classical monocular pipelines fail.
tldr_zh: 该报告在低光序列上基准测试了纯RGB SLAM系统，发现只有结合IMU融合和全局优化的Kimera-VIO能跟踪所有序列，而经典单目方法会失败。

title: Stability and Comfort in Mobile Robot-Pedestrian Interactions
summary: Mobile robots in public spaces must ensure pedestrians' comfort, and yet empirical studies of walkers' subjective safety are rare. Many classical navigation algorithms do not distinguish the walkers from dynamic obstacles and do not explicitly model subjective human factors. Moreover, most studies focus on holonomic mobile robots, whereas applications demand Nonholonomic Mobile Robots (NMR). This paper develops socially aware algorithms for NMRs, proves the stability, verifies the performance experimentally, and statistically analyzes the reported comfort. We design a framework for NMRs using Social Force Model (SFM) and the projected Time-to-collision Social Force Model (TSFM). We formalize the NMR-pedestrians' and NMR-obstacles' interactions and prove the system's stability, assuming boundedly nonpassive pedestrians. Simulations calibrate the models by maximizing a hybrid cost function of comfort and speed. Pedestrian-robot interaction experiments compare SFM and TSFM to two remote-controlled baselines and collect walkers' reported comfort. Statistical tools analyze survey results collected during the experiments. Benchmarking the algorithms against previous studies highlights the proposed methods' advantage with respect to the studied metrics. Overall, the models are stable and improve pedestrian comfort when an NMR navigates through a pedestrian crowd.
summary_zh: 公共空间中的移动机器人必须保障行人的舒适感，然而关于步行者主观安全性的实证研究仍十分罕见。许多经典导航算法未能将行人区别于动态障碍物，也未明确建模主观人因要素。此外，多数研究聚焦于全向移动机器人，而实际应用需求却指向非完整约束移动机器人（NMR）。本文针对非完整约束移动机器人开发了具有社会感知能力的算法，证明了其稳定性，通过实验验证了性能，并对报告舒适度进行了统计分析。我们基于社会力模型（SFM）和投影碰撞时间社会力模型（TSFM）设计了非完整约束移动机器人的算法框架。我们形式化描述了非完整约束移动机器人-行人及非完整约束移动机器人-障碍物的交互关系，并在假设行人具有有界非被动性的条件下证明了系统的稳定性。通过最大化包含舒适度与速度的混合代价函数，仿真实验对模型进行了校准。在行人-机器人交互实验中，我们将SFM与TSFM两种模型与两个遥控基准方案进行对比，并收集了步行者报告的舒适度数据。采用统计工具分析了实验期间收集的问卷调查结果。将算法与既往研究进行基准测试，突显了所提方法在各项评估指标上的优势。总体而言，所提模型具有稳定性，能够有效提升非完整约束移动机器人在行人群体中穿行时行人的舒适度。
tldr: This paper develops socially aware navigation algorithms for nonholonomic mobile robots using Social Force and Time-to-Collision Social Force Models, with stability proofs and human comfort experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文为非完整移动机器人开发了基于社会力模型和碰撞时间社会力模型的社交感知导航算法，并进行了稳定性证明和人类舒适度实验。

title: PGN: Design and Implementation of a Vision-Language Navigation System Based on Pangu Multimodal Foundation Model
summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to interpret a natural-language instruction and predict actions from temporally ordered visual observations. Adapting a multimodal large language model to VLN requires visual-language alignment, compact temporal inputs, action-space grounding, and stable training on the target hardware. This technical report presents PGN (Pangu Navigator), an offline VLN action-prediction system built on OpenPangu-7B. Training proceeds in two stages. First, PGMM aligns a frozen EVA-ViT-G/14 vision encoder with the frozen language backbone by training a Q-Former and a two-layer MLP projector. Second, PGN adapts the aligned model to expert navigation trajectories using five-observation windows, epoch-dependent temporal sampling, and a reasoning-then-action output format; this stage freezes the aligned visual pathway and updates three structural-token embeddings and LoRA adapters. The implementation combines mixed-precision computation, selective FP32 computation, and DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 on eight Ascend 910B NPUs. Under teacher-forced, open-loop evaluation on 500 held-out expert trajectories, V9 reports a 62.29% Normalized Action Match (NAM) and a 100.00% Non-empty Rate (NER). These metrics quantify offline expert-action alignment rather than closed-loop navigation success; evaluating error accumulation, path efficiency, and goal completion remains future work.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言导航（VLN）要求具身智能体理解自然语言指令，并根据时间顺序的视觉观测预测动作。将多模态大语言模型适配至VLN任务需要视觉-语言对齐、紧凑的时间输入处理、动作空间 grounding 以及在目标硬件上进行稳定训练。本技术报告提出PGN（盘古导航器），这是一个基于OpenPangu-7B构建的离线VLN动作预测系统。训练分为两个阶段：第一阶段，PGMM通过训练Q-Former和两层MLP投影器，将冻结的EVA-ViT-G/14视觉编码器与冻结的语言骨干网络对齐；第二阶段，PGN采用五观测窗口、基于epoch的时间采样以及“推理-动作”输出格式，将对齐后的模型适配至专家导航轨迹。此阶段冻结对齐后的视觉通路，并更新三个结构化词元嵌入与LoRA适配器。实现中混合了混合精度计算、选择性FP32计算以及在八块Ascend 910B NPU上部署的DeepSpeed ZeRO-2。在500条保留的专家轨迹上采用教师强制开环评估时，V9版本报告了62.29%的归一化动作匹配率（NAM）和100.00%的非空率（NER）。这些指标衡量的是离线专家动作对齐程度，而非闭环导航成功率；误差累积、路径效率及目标完成度的评估仍有待未来工作。
tldr: The paper presents PGN, a Vision-Language Navigation system that fine-tunes OpenPangu-7B using Q-Former alignment and LoRA adapters to predict expert actions from visual-language inputs.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出PGN，一种视觉语言导航系统，通过Q-Former对齐和LoRA适配器微调OpenPangu-7B，从视觉-语言输入中预测专家动作。

title: RayOcc: Occlusion-Aware Ray Occupancy Estimation via Gaussian Mixture Intensity
summary: Camera-only 3D semantic occupancy prediction aims to infer voxel-wise scene semantics from multi-view images, yet remains fundamentally challenging due to depth ambiguity and occlusion. Along a single camera ray, multiple spatially separated surfaces may coexist, making occupancy inherently a multi-label existence problem rather than a single-depth estimation task. However, most existing approaches favor a single dominant depth hypothesis per ray, limiting their ability to model volumetric scenes under complex occlusion. To address this limitation, we introduce RayOcc, an occlusion-aware ray occupancy framework that reformulates ray modeling as multi-label existence prediction. Instead of predicting a categorical depth distribution, RayOcc estimates a non-normalized Gaussian mixture intensity along each ray and converts it into interval-wise occupancy probabilities via a Poisson event formulation, allowing multiple occupied hypotheses to coexist without enforcing mutual competition across depth. The predicted mixture components are interpreted as occupancy hypotheses to initialize sparse 3D Gaussian primitives, which are refined and rasterized for semantic occupancy prediction. Experiments on the nuScenes benchmark show that RayOcc achieves state-of-the-art overall IoU and mIoU among the compared Gaussian-based occupancy methods.
summary_zh: 纯视觉三维语义占据预测旨在从多视角图像中推断体素级别的场景语义，但由于深度模糊性和遮挡问题，该任务仍面临根本性挑战。沿单条相机光线可能存在多个空间分离的表面，这使得占据预测本质上是一个多标签共存问题，而非单一深度估计任务。然而，现有方法大多倾向于为每条光线假设一个主导深度，限制了其在复杂遮挡条件下建模体素场景的能力。为解决这一局限，我们提出RayOcc——一种遮挡感知的光线占据框架，将光线建模重新定义为多标签共存预测任务。RayOcc不预测分类深度分布，而是沿每条光线估计非归一化的高斯混合强度，并通过泊松事件公式将其转换为区间级别的占据概率，使得多个占据假设能够共存而无需在深度维度上相互竞争。预测出的混合分量被解释为占据假设，用于初始化稀疏三维高斯基元，随后通过优化和栅格化实现语义占据预测。在nuScenes基准上的实验表明，在基于高斯方法的占据预测模型中，RayOcc实现了最优的整体交并比和平均交并比。
tldr: RayOcc proposes an occlusion-aware ray occupancy model using Gaussian mixture intensity and Poisson event formulation to predict multi-label occupancy per ray, achieving state-of-the-art results on nuScenes for camera-only 3D semantic occupancy prediction.
tldr_zh: RayOcc提出了一种通过高斯混合强度和泊松事件公式实现的遮挡感知射线占据模型，用于预测每条射线的多标签占据情况，在nuScenes基准上达到了基于高斯占据方法的当前最优结果。

title: FlashRT: Agent Harness for Guiding Agents to Deploy Real-Time Multimodal Applications
summary: Real-time multimodal applications, including voice agents and interactive video generation, compose heterogeneous models into pipelines whose efficient deployment requires application-specific decisions about placement, streaming, and intra-model parallelism. Existing serving systems and auto-parallelism compilers commit to limited transformations and fixed workload assumptions, so achieving high performance on a new application requires hand-crafting an efficient implementation. We present FlashRT, an agent harness that guides coding agents to lift simple developer-written reference implementations into optimized multi-GPU deployments that flexibly weigh target metrics like latency and throughput. Using a new chain-of-program paradigm, FlashRT directs a generic coding agent through a multi-pass transformation process where an agent transforms the reference into an intermediate representation (IR) to capture data dependencies and persistent-state scopes, validates this IR via a sequential interpreter, and performs static analyses to identify candidate transformations. Then, the agent iteratively implements, verifies, and benchmarks each candidate under a measurement-gated optimization loop to produce effective deployments that span different hardware budgets. Across various applications, including video world models and multimodal LLMs, FlashRT converts reference implementations into highly efficient deployments, delivering up to ~70x latency reduction and 2.8x throughput improvement on NVIDIA B200 GPUs. On AMD MI355X GPUs, FlashRT matches the peak latency reduction while increasing peak throughput improvement to 3.6x, demonstrating that agent-driven optimization can be more scalable on platforms with less mature expert optimization. In fact, for Qwen3-Omni text-to-audio inference, FlashRT reduces response latency by 65% compared to the expert vLLM-Omni implementation on AMD MI355X.
summary_zh: 实时多模态应用，包括语音智能体和交互式视频生成，将异构模型组合成流水线，其高效部署需要针对具体应用做出关于放置、流式传输和模型内并行性的决策。现有的服务系统和自动并行编译器局限于有限的转换方式和固定的工作负载假设，因此要在一个新应用上获得高性能，需要手工制作高效的实现方案。我们提出FlashRT，这是一种智能体框架，它引导编码智能体将简单的开发者编写参考实现提升为优化的多GPU部署，并灵活权衡延迟与吞吐量等目标指标。通过采用新的程序链范式，FlashRT引导通用编码智能体执行多轮转换流程：智能体将参考实现转换为中间表示以捕获数据依赖性和持久状态范围，通过顺序解释器验证此中间表示，并执行静态分析以识别候选转换。随后，智能体在测量门控优化循环中迭代实现、验证并对每个候选方案进行基准测试，从而生成适配不同硬件预算的高效部署。在各种应用中，包括视频世界模型和多模态大语言模型，FlashRT将参考实现转化为高效部署，在NVIDIA B200 GPU上实现了高达约70倍的延迟降低和2.8倍的吞吐量提升。在AMD MI355X GPU上，FlashRT保持了同等峰值延迟降低幅度，同时将峰值吞吐量提升幅度增至3.6倍，这表明在专家优化成熟度较低的平台，智能体驱动的优化可具备更高扩展性。事实上，针对Qwen3-Omni文本到音频推理任务，FlashRT在AMD MI355X上相比专家级vLLM-Omni实现可降低65%的响应延迟。
tldr: FlashRT is an agent harness that guides coding agents to automatically optimize and deploy real-time multimodal applications (e.g., video world models and multimodal LLMs) onto multi-GPU systems by iteratively transforming, validating, and benchmarking reference implementations.
tldr_zh: FlashRT 是一个智能体框架，指导编码智能体自动优化和部署实时多模态应用（例如视频世界模型和多模态大语言模型）到多 GPU 系统上，通过迭代地转换、验证和基准测试参考实现来实现。

title: Imitation of Arm Gestures by the Semi-Humanoid Robot NICO
summary: Seamless human-robot interaction (HRI) requires a number of perceptual and motor abilities from the robot, one of them being the imitation of human gestures. Humanoid robots have an advantage in HRI thanks to their anthropomorphic features. In this work, we develop a system for imitation of human arm gestures by the semi-humanoid robot NICO based on analytical geometry and a pretrained MediaPipe pose-estimation model. For each input RGB frame, 3D coordinates of relevant human body landmarks, including arm joints and hand keypoints, are obtained using the MediaPipe framework. Joint angles are then computed from these coordinates using derived geometric relations. Finally, the computed angles are properly mapped to NICO's motor configuration and executed in a predefined motion sequence. Preliminary experiments on several representative arm gestures with six participants of different height indicate that the proposed method can produce meaningful imitative motions from monocular RGB input only, while also highlighting limitations in more complex poses and wrist-related movements.
tldr: This paper presents a system for the semi-humanoid robot NICO to imitate human arm gestures from monocular RGB video using MediaPipe pose estimation and geometric joint-angle computation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个系统，使半人形机器人NICO能够通过单目RGB视频，利用MediaPipe姿态估计和几何关节角度计算来模仿人类手臂手势。

title: UMCP: A Unified Multi-Task Collaborative Perception Network for Luggage Trolley Pose Estimation
summary: In robotic autonomous luggage trolley collection, robots must continuously localize scattered luggage trolleys in cluttered and dynamic environments. This requires the vision system to achieve both high accuracy and real-time performance. However, existing visual perception approaches for luggage trolleys often rely on cascaded multi-model inference, leading to increased inference latency and high deployment costs. To address these limitations, this article presents a unified multi-task collaborative perception network (UMCP) that simultaneously performs luggage trolley detection, keypoint detection and orientation estimation. Based on the YOLOv12 architecture, keypoint features are fused with orientation features and then fed into an orientation feature enhancement module (OFEM), thereby improving orientation estimation accuracy. In addition, circular probability distribution modeling with a Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence loss is adopted to enhance orientation estimation accuracy further. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves competitive overall accuracy while substantially reducing model complexity and computational cost compared with existing methods. A website about this work is available at https://sites.google.com/view/robot-umcp.
tldr: The paper proposes UMCP, a unified multi-task perception network based on YOLOv12 that simultaneously performs detection, keypoint detection, and orientation estimation for luggage trolley pose estimation in robotic autonomous collection.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了UMCP，一种基于YOLOv12的统一多任务协作感知网络，可同时进行行李车检测、关键点检测和方向估计，用于机器人自主收集行李车。

title: Lifelong Localization in Dynamic Indoor Environments Combining Odometry with Sparse Distance Sampling
summary: Localization is a key task in robot navigation, and many techniques exist for it. In many plausible scenarios, a robot might face unforeseen, dynamic obstacles, rendering any pre-determined map inaccurate for localization. In this work, we propose a robust lifelong localization framework in dynamic planar indoor environments, using the robot's odometry and sparse distance sampling. We demonstrate how distance samples can be used to provide a robust prior on the robot's location. This technique can solve the kidnapped robot problem in real time, up to symmetries. Based on insights from real-world recorded data, we also account for dynamic obstacles. We then fuse this prior, over time, with the odometry to converge to the robot's location. A central property of our method is that it provably converges to the robot's ground truth pose even in large indoor environments when the environment is static. We further show that this guarantee also holds in dynamic environments, as long as the nature of those changes has been correctly learned. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in different real-world indoor environments. In particular, we achieve a localization comparable to SLAM with merely a few (sixteen) distance samples, as opposed to the full LiDAR range. Sufficing with only sparse distance sampling is advantageous in terms of sensor cost, privacy, storage space, and transmission bandwidth.
tldr: This paper presents a lifelong localization framework that combines robot odometry with a sparse set of distance samples (e.g., 16 samples) to robustly localize in dynamic indoor environments, achieving SLAM-comparable accuracy while reducing sensor cost and data requirements.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种结合机器人里程计和稀疏距离采样（例如16个样本）的终身定位框架，能在动态室内环境中实现鲁棒定位，达到与SLAM相当的精度，同时降低传感器成本和数据需求。

title: COLIP-2: Olfaction-Vision-Language Embeddings
summary: The Contrastive Olfaction-Language-Image Pre-training 2 (COLIP-2) model is a multimodal embeddings space that places olfaction as a first-class citizen among vision and language. Molecular structure, gas-sensor readings, odor-descriptor language, and images are all trained into a single shared representation space, so that a robot can localize a detected aroma to objects in a scene probabilistically. No ImageNet-scale datasets of paired image-scent examples exists which warrants the need for their collection. Our intent with the release of COLIP-2 is to demonstrate the limit of what can be built for robotics with open-sourced olfactory data in order to ground the argument for why new methodologies and datasets are necessary in order to enable advanced olfactory-oriented perception capabilities. We enumerate results from internal testing of the COLIP-2 architecture and make necessary optimizations to run the model at the edge for real-time robotics applications. While developed with robotics in mind, the design of COLIP-2 has been influenced by experts across many disciplines of science in academia and industry, and we hope that the model can be useful in any multimodal domain requiring olfactory intelligence.
tldr: COLIP-2 is a multimodal embedding model integrating olfaction, vision, and language into a shared space, enabling robots to probabilistically localize detected aromas to objects in a scene.
tldr_zh: COLIP-2是一个将嗅觉、视觉和语言集成到共享空间的多模态嵌入模型，使机器人能够将检测到的气味概率性地定位到场景中的物体。

title: RT-SHCUA: Real-Time Self-Hosted Computer-Use Agent for UAV Control
summary:
Natural-language control offers a promising interface for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), but directly applying self-hosted computer-use agents (SHCUAs) to UAV control introduces a structural mismatch. SHCUAs are designed for interactive host-side tool use, where delayed agent iterations are often acceptable. UAV control, however, is coupled with continuously changing physical states, strict timing constraints, safety risks, and security accountability. A stale, unauthorized, or tampered agent decision may therefore lead to unsafe or untraceable vehicle behavior.
  This paper proposes a real-time and security-oriented restructuring of SHCUA-based UAV control. Instead of allowing an SHCUA to directly issue flight commands, we transform its outputs into contract-bound UAV skill invocations with explicit timing, state, authority, fallback, and evidence semantics. Based on this abstraction, we design an architecture that separates semantic reasoning from onboard execution and security/safety enforcement. Slow cloud or edge reasoning is used for mission understanding, while onboard components validate and dispatch only timely, authorized, and state-consistent skills. Security-critical enforcement points can be protected by TEE-style or microcontroller isolation mechanisms without moving the full language agent or high-frequency flight-control loop into trusted components. Prototype evaluation shows that RT-SHCUA maintains bounded task-level responsiveness while supporting degraded handling, trusted admission, and auditable evidence preservation for SHCUA-mediated UAV actions.
tldr: This paper restructures self-hosted computer-use agents (SHCUAs) for real-time, secure UAV control by separating semantic reasoning from onboard execution, using contract-bound skill invocations to ensure timing, safety, and auditability.
tldr_zh: 本文通过将语义推理与机载执行分离，并使用合同约束的技能调用来确保实时性、安全性和可审计性，重新构建了自托管计算机使用代理（SHCUA）以用于无人机实时安全控制。

title: Value-Aware Prediction for Robust Multi-Agent Coordination Under Communication Loss
summary: Robust multi-agent coordination relies heavily on inter-agent communication, which is frequently disrupted by physical and environmental constraints in real-world deployments. To maintain operation during these intermittent communication failures, agents can employ internal prediction models to estimate missing shared state information. However, predictors trained with standard reconstruction objectives treat all transitions equally. In a Reinforcement Learning context, this forces the model to waste capacity learning stochastic exploration noise and the outdated dynamics of suboptimal policies. In this paper, we propose a value-aware extension of Multi-Agent Observation Sharing under Communication Dropout (MARO) to patch communication gaps; we refer to this method as Value-Aware MARO. By dynamically weighting the predictor's loss function using advantage estimates derived from the underlying actor-critic architecture, our objective explicitly couples the predictor's learning process to the policy's evolution. This formulation focuses the model's capacity on the intentional, high-return dynamics actively reinforced by the agents. We evaluate our framework on several tasks within the Multi-Agent Particle Environment under varying communication reliability levels. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach maintains performance under declining communication reliability, particularly below 40%. While our method performs comparably in tasks where the baseline already maintains high coordination, our value-aware weighting effectively prevents the performance collapse observed in the standard predictor during high-attrition scenarios. In these environments, our method achieves an average improvement in mean returns of more than 20% and reduces performance variance by a mean of 64.7% compared to the standard unweighted baseline.
tldr: Proposes a value-aware loss weighting for multi-agent prediction models that prioritize high-return dynamics, improving coordination under communication dropout.
tldr_zh: 提出一种价值感知的损失加权方法，使多智能体预测模型优先关注高回报动态，在通信中断时提升协调性能。

title: Task-Space Constrained Stochastic Trajectory Optimization for Time-Optimal Forestry Crane Motion Planning
summary: Efficient, collision-free, and time-optimal motion planning is a fundamental requirement for autonomous forestry cranes operating under hydraulic pump-flow constraints. The Via-Point-based Stochastic Trajectory Optimization (VP-STO) algorithm has demonstrated near-time-optimal hybrid motion planning in this domain, but requires a fixed terminal joint configuration specified prior to optimization. For kinematically redundant manipulators such as forestry cranes, this pre-commitment to a single inverse kinematics solution restricts the planner's ability to exploit redundancy, particularly under the nonlinear, globally coupled pump-flow constraint where admissible joint velocities depend on their combined hydraulic demand. This paper presents TSC-VP-STO, a task-space-constrained extension of VP-STO that replaces the strict terminal joint-space constraint with a task-space constraint, jointly optimizing the trajectory and the redundant degrees of freedom of the terminal configuration. This enables the planner to adapt end configurations to the environment-dependent motion and hydraulic flow allocation, yielding more balanced pump utilization and shorter trajectory durations. We formalize the approach through a configuration space decomposition and derive a concrete reachability constraint for the forestry crane kinematics. Experimental evaluations across multiple planning targets and via-point configurations demonstrates a reduction on trajectory durations by 12-15% on average and improved pump-flow utilization compared to the baseline VP-STO. The practical applicability of TSC-VP-STO is validated through real-world deployment on a forestry crane, including a full log-loading cycle.
tldr: This paper extends the VP-STO algorithm for forestry cranes by replacing fixed terminal joint constraints with task-space constraints, enabling the planner to jointly optimize trajectories and redundant degrees of freedom, achieving 12-15% faster motion under hydraulic flow limits and validated on a real crane.
tldr_zh: 本文针对林业起重机，将VP-STO算法中固定的末端关节约束替换为任务空间约束，使得规划器能够联合优化轨迹和冗余自由度，在液压流量限制下实现12-15%的速度提升，并在真实起重机上验证。

title: Polar Coordinate-based Differential Evolution for Moving Target Search Using Vision Sensor on Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
summary: In search and rescue operations, there is a period known as the "golden time" during which the probability of finding the target alive is highest. The objective of this work is to propose a new search algorithm for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) with a focus on improving the detection probability and execution time. We approach this problem by first modeling target dynamics as a Markov process and the detection likelihood as a function of image quality and the observer's vision. We then employ Bayesian theory to derive a fitness function representing the probability distribution of the target's location over the search area. Finally, we introduce a new algorithm named polar coordinate-based differential evolution (PDE) to generate a UAV search path that maximizes this fitness function. The PDE algorithm utilizes polar coordinates to incorporate kinematic constraints and maneuver properties of the UAV, allowing for better exploration of the solution space. A series of simulations and comparative analyses have been conducted to evaluate the performance of the proposed algorithm. Experiments involving a real UAV have also been conducted. Results demonstrate that the PDE algorithm outperforms state-of-the-art algorithms in terms of detection probability and execution time across diverse search scenarios while remaining practical for real-world applications. The source code of the algorithm is available at https://github.com/thuhangkhuat/PDE_target_search.
tldr: This paper proposes a new search algorithm for UAVs using polar coordinate-based differential evolution to improve moving target detection probability and execution time, validated through simulation and real UAV experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于极坐标差分进化的新搜索算法，用于无人机移动目标搜索，以提高检测概率和执行时间，并通过仿真和真实无人机实验进行了验证。

title: Configuration-Induced Passive Self-Rotation for Perception-Enhanced Autonomous Flight
summary: Autonomous flight in confined and cluttered environments is fundamentally limited by the restricted field of view (FoV) of onboard sensors. Passive self-rotation expands sensing coverage without additional sensors but introduces a tradeoff between swept-FoV refresh rate and flight performance. This letter presents a configuration-induced passively self-rotating tricopter for perception-enhanced autonomous flight. Firstly, the rear-arm configuration parameter is exploited to regulate the passive self-rotation operating point, providing an airframe-level mechanism for balancing swept-FoV refresh rate and flight performance. Secondly, a hierarchical autonomy framework integrating planning and control is developed to enable agile and robust autonomous flight under continuous passive self-rotation. For waypoint-based inspection, guide-point replanning is further used to improve task-level coverage. Extensive real-world experiments, including high-speed trajectory tracking, disturbance-rejection tests, and autonomous navigation in representative cluttered environments, demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach for perception-enhanced autonomous flight.
tldr: This paper presents a passively self-rotating tricopter design and a hierarchical autonomy framework to enhance perception for autonomous flight in cluttered environments, balancing FoV refresh rate and flight performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种被动自旋三旋翼无人机设计及分层自主框架，通过机身构型参数调节感知覆盖与飞行性能的平衡，实现受限环境下的高效自主飞行。

title: Finite-Time Curvature-Constrained Vector Field for Saturation-Free Motion Planning of Nonholonomic Robots
summary: Accurately steering a robot to a target configuration is fundamental in engineering, yet remains challenging for nonholonomic mobile robots. Vector fields (VFs) provide a natural framework by specifying desired motion directions throughout the workspace and enabling direct integration with feedback control. However, most existing VF-based methods cannot explicitly generate trajectories satisfying curvature constraints. Actuator limits are therefore often enforced by input saturation, which may invalidate stability guarantees and degrade closed-loop performance when not considered in controller design. In addition, these methods usually ensure only asymptotic convergence without an explicit settling-time bound. To address these issues, we propose a generalized motion planning and control framework consisting of a finite-time curvature-constrained vector field (FT-C2VF) and a saturation-free control law. Depending on the motion objective, the framework drives the robot to the target configuration in finite time or through it periodically. First, the FT-C2VF is constructed using complementary gains to achieve finite-time convergence while ensuring that the curvature of its integral curves is continuous, bounded, and monotonically decreasing with the radial ratio. Second, an almost globally C1-smooth, saturation-free controller is developed to track the FT-C2VF without Jacobian information, while keeping all control inputs within prescribed actuator limits. Third, dynamical-systems analysis establishes almost-global finite-time stability of the target equilibrium. Numerical simulations show improved performance over representative VF-based methods, and outdoor experiments on an Ackermann-steered vehicle confirm the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed approach.
tldr: This paper proposes a finite-time curvature-constrained vector field and a saturation-free control law for nonholonomic robots, ensuring bounded curvature and prescribed actuator limits with finite-time convergence. It is validated via simulation and outdoor experiments on an Ackermann-steered vehicle.
tldr_zh: 本文为欠驱动轮式机器人提出了一种有限时间曲率约束向量场与无饱和控制律，保证曲率有界且符合执行器限幅，并实现有限时间收敛。仿真和实车实验验证了其有效性。

title: Disturbance-Aware Flight for Aerial Robots in Narrow Space
summary: Autonomous flight of aerial robots in narrow space remains challenging due to strong aerodynamic disturbances and limited flying space. Existing approaches mainly address aerodynamic disturbances at the control level, while motion planning typically relies on geometric constraints and fixed speed limits, leading to conservative or unsafe behaviors in confined environments. This paper presents a disturbance-aware planning and control framework (DAPCF) that integrates online disturbance estimation into the planning-control loop for quadrotor flight in narrow space. First, the dual-loop observers estimate 6-degree-of-freedom disturbance forces and torques in real time based on odometry and motor speed measurements. Then, a disturbance risk function is introduced that adaptively modulates the reference speed of the planner based on disturbance estimation, reducing velocity when disturbances exceed a threshold and restoring it under low-disturbance conditions. Finally, a motor-dynamics-based nonlinear model predictive controller (MDNMPC) with disturbance compensation is designed to ensure robust trajectory tracking under perturbed conditions. Experiments demonstrate that a quadrotor with a diagonal length of 0.39~m can traverse straight, sloped, and curved tunnels as narrow as 0.6~m, outperforming human pilots in both success rate and flight efficiency.
tldr: This paper proposes a disturbance-aware planning and control framework for quadrotor flight in narrow spaces, integrating online disturbance estimation to adaptively modulate speed and compensate for aerodynamic effects, enabling traversal of tunnels as narrow as 0.6m.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向窄空间四旋翼飞行的扰动感知规划与控制框架，通过在线扰动估计自适应调节速度并进行补偿，实现了在宽仅0.6米的隧道中的自主穿越。

title: Remote Awareness of Seafloor Images Collected by AUVs over Low-Bandwidth Communication Links
summary: This paper introduces a method for real-time processing and transmission of autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) imagery over low-bandwidth communication links. It leverages artificial intelligence (AI) techniques to identify a set of images that best represent an entire dataset, or automatically finds the most similar images to a given query image for transmission to operators. Combined with metadata of a larger set of images, compressed versions of the selected images can be transmitted over satellite communication links or underwater modems, and provide operators on shore with information about the type of imagery the AUV is collecting while it is still deployed. Data from three deployments off the coast of the UK and in Gran Canaria using different AUVs and imaging systems demonstrate the method in the field. It achieved an almost 400,000-fold reduction in data volume compared to the raw data size, enabling transmission of data summaries of a 2-hour 47-minute-long mapping mission in just over 34 minutes over low-bandwidth satellite communication.
tldr: This paper presents an AI-based method for real-time selection and compression of AUV seafloor images for transmission over low-bandwidth links, achieving a 400,000-fold data reduction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于AI的实时选择和压缩AUV海底图像的方法，以在低带宽链路上传输，实现了近40万倍的数据缩减。

title: Does Robust VIO Need More Learning? Geometry-Verified Visual Measurements under Distribution Shift
summary: Learning is increasingly introduced into visual-inertial odometry (VIO), ranging from learned feature front-ends to learning-dominant motion and geometry estimation. However, learning more of the pipeline does not necessarily improve robustness when deployment conditions differ from the training distribution. This work asks whether robust VIO under distribution shift truly requires deeper learned estimation, or whether learning can be confined to visual measurement generation. We propose a minimal-learning stereo VIO framework in which SEA-RAFT is used only to propose dense stereo correspondences and predict their uncertainty, while temporal tracking, geometric verification, and state estimation remain explicit. Dense flow is sampled at sparse feature locations, filtered using predicted uncertainty and stereo epipolar consistency, and incorporated into a sliding-window stereo-inertial estimator through uncertainty-weighted reprojection factors. The same uncertainty is further propagated through stereo triangulation for downstream anisotropic 3D Gaussian mapping. Experiments on EuRoC, VIODE, and 4Seasons demonstrate accurate and stable estimation under motion blur, dynamic scenes, illumination changes, and large indoor-to-outdoor distribution shifts. Ablations show that learned flow alone is insufficient: the gains arise from combining learned correspondence proposals with geometric verification and uncertainty-aware weighting. These results suggest that, for OOD-robust VIO, carefully integrated learned visual measurements can be more effective than learning a larger fraction of the estimation pipeline. Code and configs for the benchmark will be open-source upon acceptance. A supplementary video is available at https://drive.google.com/file/d/1EVRhOkhanmNXHbQS1Vr80FoEIAYOYOV2/view
tldr: This paper proposes a minimal-learning stereo VIO framework that constrains learning to dense stereo correspondence and uncertainty prediction while keeping tracking, geometric verification, and state estimation explicit, demonstrating robust performance under distribution shifts without deeper learned estimation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种最小学习的立体视觉惯性里程计框架，将学习仅限于稠密立体对应和不确定性预测，同时保持跟踪、几何验证和状态估计的显式性，在分布偏移下展现出鲁棒性能，而无需更深层的学习估计。

title: Lifelong Multi-Subsystem Pickup and Delivery with Buffer-Limited Handover Stations
summary: Coordinating payload transfers between subsystems is a critical challenge in lifelong Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery (MAPD). We study systems where agents are confined to separate regions and must exchange payloads through shared handover stations. These stations, equipped with single docks and finite buffers, are inherently vulnerable to blocking and starvation. We formalize this problem as Multi-Subsystem MAPD with Buffer-limited Handover Stations (MS-MAPD-BHS). We then propose Handover-Aware Reservation and Routing (HARR), an online controller that couples per-subsystem planners. HARR uses a shared dock reservation calendar and a deterministic rolling-horizon projection of buffer occupancy to coordinate actions. A candidate route is accepted only if its dock interval is free and the resulting buffer occupancy projection remains within capacity. Under perfect execution, these checks ensure collision-free dock use and buffer-safe committed operations within the reservation horizon. In simulation, HARR achieves up to 77% higher throughput and 92% lower backlog than a fixed-dock ablation at moderate load, while also reducing planning time relative to a coupled station-aware Token Passing baseline. These results show that explicit interface coordination substantially improves stability in modular multi-subsystem transport.
tldr: This paper formalizes a multi-subsystem pickup and delivery problem with buffer-limited handover stations and proposes an online coordination controller (HARR) that improves throughput and reduces backlog via shared reservation and buffer occupancy projection.
tldr_zh: 本文形式化了具有有限缓冲区交接站的多子系统取货与配送问题，并提出了一种在线协调控制器HARR，通过共享预约和缓冲区占用投影来提高吞吐量并减少积压。

title: Mobile Network Control with a World Model
summary: The increasing complexity of mobile networks necessitates intelligent and dynamic control strategies for efficient, energy-conserving management. We propose a world model-based approach for network control that enables adaptive configuration of crucial parameters. The world model is trained from historical data and predicts the impact of its actions on future network states. Our controller leverages the model's uncertainty estimate to robustly find optimal network configuration changes. Furthermore, the optimization objective can be changed dynamically without model retraining. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach in simulated closed-loop control of a mobile network energy-saving feature. Our results show improved performance in balancing energy savings with quality of service, compared to traditional methods and reinforcement learning approaches. Finally, we show the world model performance on real network data from, and evaluate counterfactual actions proposed by the controller under various throughput constraints.
tldr: This paper applies a world model to mobile network control, enabling adaptive parameter configuration and dynamic objective changes without retraining, with results in simulation and real data.
tldr_zh: 本文将世界模型应用于移动网络控制，实现无需重新训练的自适应参数配置和动态目标调整，并在模拟和真实数据上验证了效果。

title: Attention from Above: A Multimodal Model for Drone-Based Object Localization
summary: Drone-based object detection technology has advanced rapidly, becoming increasingly sophisticated and efficient. Recently, research trends have expanded beyond the detection of predefined objects toward the identification of specified target objects. For example, desired targets can be specified through textual prompts, enabling accurate detection of objects of interest. To address this demand, this paper proposes an efficient multimodal-based object detection model aimed at improving small object detection performance. The proposed method is built upon the YOLO-World framework and replaces the C2f layers used in the YOLOv8 backbone with attention-based A2C2f layers. This modification enables more precise representation of local features, particularly for small objects or objects with well-defined boundaries. In addition, the incorporation of attention mechanisms and parallel processing structures significantly enhances the model's computational accuracy. Comparative experiments conducted on the VisDrone dataset demonstrate that the proposed model outperforms the original YOLO-World model. Specifically, precision increases from 43.0% to 45.1%, recall from 32.8% to 35.0%, the F1 score from 37.2% to 39.4%, mAP@0.5 from 32.5% to 35.2%, and mAP@0.5-0.95 from 18.5% to 19.9%, confirming a substantial improvement in detection accuracy. These results verify that the proposed approach provides an effective and highly accurate solution for object detection in drone-based image and video application environments.
tldr: This paper improves YOLO-World for drone-based object detection by replacing C2f layers with attention-based A2C2f layers in the YOLOv8 backbone, achieving gains on the VisDrone dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文通过在YOLOv8骨干网络中使用基于注意力的A2C2f层替换C2f层，改进了YOLO-World的无人机目标检测性能，并在VisDrone数据集上取得了提升。

title: Planning with Transformers: Chain of Computation and Structured Context Windows
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have had a remarkable impact across many areas of machine learning. However, recent studies have shown that they struggle to reliably solve planning problems. At the same time, theoretical results have shown that transformers, the core architecture underlying modern LLMs, are Turing-complete. In this work, we investigate this apparent gap between the theoretical computational power of LLMs and their empirical planning performance. We propose Chain of Computation (COC), a computational architecture that places a transformer-based LM inside an iterative loop, leveraging its strength as a pattern-matching system. The COC uses a Structured Context Window (SCW) which provides a constant-sized context window with support for choosing which window is used at each planning step. Within this architecture, the LM is able to learn a planning policy, predicts the world model, and performs the arithmetic operations required during planning.
